items.title: GPT-6 十月版：安全指标进步，为什么仍会出现退步项？

fields.Agent 边界有改善，仍须保留成功口径和模拟环境: Agent boundaries improve, but success criteria and simulated settings still matter
fields.FieldToFit 分析：这份卡片的价值是让“模型更安全”变成可追问的问题：比: FieldToFit analysis: the value of this card is to turn a broad safety claim into specific questions: which product and month, which task and denominator, and which safeguard layer? Readers can use those questions to assess their own agent workflows rather than infer all real-world outcomes from one score.
fields.GPT-5.6 八月版与 GPT-6 十月版成功绕过环境限制的条件失败率: Conditional failure rates for successful environmental-restriction circumvention: GPT-5.6 August versus GPT-6 October
fields.GPT-5.6 八月版与 GPT-6 十月版；分数为 0–100，越高越好。: GPT-5.6 August versus GPT-6 October; scores range from 0–100 and higher is better.
fields.GPT-6 Sol 十月版：原始 62.2、校正 55.2、平均 4,360 字: GPT-6 Sol October: raw 62.2, adjusted 55.2, mean 4,360 characters. GPT-5.6 Sol August: 56.6, 54.0, 2,894 characters. Gains after adjustment are smaller than the impression from raw scores alone.
fields.GPT-6 十月版：安全指标进步，为什么仍会出现退步项？: GPT-6 in October: why safety gains can coexist with regressions
fields.HealthBench 进步要连同回答长度和校正口径读: Read HealthBench gains with answer length and adjustment rules
fields.Luna 对应为 57.8、48.2、5,289 字符，对照八月版 46.8、4: Luna records 57.8, 48.2 and 5,289 characters versus the August version's 46.8, 44.1 and 2,920 characters. This compares one Professional metric rather than combining other HealthBench variants into an overall score.
fields.Luna 有 0.25%样本因基础设施原因提前退出并排除。: Infrastructure issues caused 0.25% of Luna samples to exit early and be excluded.
fields.Production Benchmarks 刻意挑选既有模型尚未理想处理的困难样: Production Benchmarks deliberately select difficult cases that earlier models did not handle ideally, evaluating behavior without the full system safeguards. The report discloses regressions in some self-harm, gore, sexual-content and teen-related categories alongside manual review and adversarial testing. Neither a blanket claim of greater safety nor a real-user incident rate follows from these difficult-set results.
fields.Production Benchmarks 及青少年、多轮等评估；不含完整生产保: Production Benchmarks plus teen and multi-turn evaluations; without the full production safeguard stack.
fields.Professional 校正分改善，但原始分增长包含更长回答带来的评分机会。: Professional adjusted scores improve, while raw-score gains also reflect scoring opportunities from longer answers.
fields.Respecting Warnings 更新为成功绕过环境限制的条件失败率。: Respecting Warnings now measures conditional failure rates for successful circumvention of environmental restrictions.
fields.Respecting Warnings 考察遇到环境限制后是否仍成功绕过；新版主: Respecting Warnings tests whether a model successfully circumvents environmental restrictions. The revised main metric moves from attempts to success, improving objectivity while entangling it with model capability. At maximum reasoning effort, Sol falls from 34% to 28% and Luna from 27% to 15.9%. These are conditional failure rates in specified simulations, with evaluation-awareness and external-validity limitations explicitly discussed by the author.
fields.Sol 十月版原始 62.2 分、平均 4,360 字符；Luna 为 57.8: October Sol: raw 62.2 points and mean 4,360 characters; Luna: 57.8 points and 5,289 characters.
fields.Sol 校正分 54.0→55.2；Luna 校正分 44.1→48.2。: Sol adjusted scores: 54.0→55.2; Luna adjusted scores: 44.1→48.2.
fields.不把长度惩罚当医疗质量真值，也不从均值重建逐题结果。: Do not treat the length penalty as clinical ground truth or reconstruct per-task results from means.
fields.事实密集、历史用户报错及高风险提示三类困难集合。: Three difficult sets: factuality-heavy prompts, user-flagged historical failures and high-stakes prompts.
fields.事实性评估分别看“回答至少含一处错误”和“断言错误占比”，提示集又分事实密集、用: Factuality distinguishes responses containing at least one error from the fraction of erroneous claims, across factuality-heavy, user-flagged and high-stakes prompt sets. The denominators differ; improvement on most metrics does not mean improvement on every metric.
fields.事实错误要说明分母: State the denominator for factual errors
fields.从四条证据链读十月系统卡：产品版本、安全回归与保护栈、HealthBench 长: Read the October system card through four evidence chains: product versions, safety regressions and safeguards, HealthBench length adjustment, and agent behavior after restrictions.
fields.以 2,000 字符为无调整点；Professional 每多 500 字符扣: Use 2,000 characters as the no-adjustment point; Professional deducts 1.47 points per additional 500 characters, with corresponding credit for shorter answers.
fields.作者将若干回归描述为整体严重性较低，并列出青少年响应分类器等额外缓解；这些是作者: The author describes reviewed regressions as generally low severity and identifies additional mitigations such as classifiers for teen responses. These are the author's review and deployment statements, not independent FieldToFit risk validation.
fields.作者报告多数指标改善，事实密集集的断言级错误为例外。: The author reports improvement on most metrics, with claim-level errors on the factuality-heavy set as the exception.
fields.作者报告披露失败减少，未在本文重绘未核完整图表的分项数值。: The author reports fewer disclosure failures; this article does not redraw component values without complete chart verification.
fields.作者结论与本站判断分开：作者报告多个边界指标改善；本站据此建议把任务完成、授权遵: Author conclusion and editorial judgment: the author reports improvements on several boundary measures; FieldToFit recommends separate acceptance checks for completion, authorization, factual verification and limitation disclosure.
fields.使用刻意困难的生产衍生样本；安全评估取最低部署推理设置。: Use deliberately difficult production-derived cases; safety evaluations use the lowest deployed reasoning settings.
fields.关键证据：表 5 把长度校正分、原始分和平均字符数放在一起，阅读时也应保留这三层: Key evidence: Table 5 reports adjusted scores, raw scores and mean characters together; interpretation should retain all three.
fields.厂商自测，本站未复现。正文保留模型月份、推理设置、评分单位与未知项；本站核对日不: Vendor evaluation, not reproduced by FieldToFit. The article preserves model months, reasoning settings, metric units and unknowns; the editorial check date does not replace the source date.
fields.厂商自测，本站未复现；主体 HTML 已完整阅读，图形仅重绘已核事实。未逐页核对: Vendor evaluation, not independently reproduced by FieldToFit. The main HTML was read in full and diagrams redraw verified facts only. No page-by-page independent PDF check or transcription of every interactive chart; no direct cross-version combination of earlier-card scores.
fields.厂商自测；只支持该基准比较，不直接衡量临床效果。: Vendor evaluation supporting this benchmark comparison, not direct clinical effectiveness.
fields.原始分增益与长度校正后的增益不同。: Raw-score gains differ from gains after length adjustment.
fields.原报告十月更新无独立编号修订；本站首次整理不记作上游实质修订。: The original October update has no independent numbered revision; this first editorial analysis is not an upstream substantive revision.
fields.原报告发表于 2026-10-07，本站于 2026-10-18 核对；首次上站: The original report was published on 2026-10-07 and checked by FieldToFit on 2026-10-18. Actual publication records determine first site publication and later revisions. The original remains linked; three diagrams are FieldToFit redraws or factual schematics, without copying upstream graphic design or independently running model evaluations.
fields.同名 Sol 与 Luna，也要先看产品和发布月份: Even Sol and Luna names need a product and release month
fields.同名模型按部署月份区分。: Models sharing a name are distinguished by deployment month.
fields.同时报告原始分、长度校正分与平均可见回答长度。: Report raw scores, length-adjusted scores and mean visible response lengths together.
fields.四个模型的 HealthBench Professional 原始分、长度校正分: HealthBench Professional raw scores, length-adjusted scores and mean response characters for four models
fields.图 1｜本站事实示意，依据报告导言；不是当前所有产品版本的实时列表。: Figure 1 | FieldToFit factual diagram based on the introduction; not a live list of current versions across all products.
fields.图 2｜本站按表 5 重绘；0–100 分，越高越好。长度单位为字符，不是 to: Figure 2 | FieldToFit redraw of Table 5; 0–100 points, higher is better. Length is measured in characters, not tokens; these are not clinical outcomes.
fields.图 3｜本站重绘图 5 正文点估计；百分比，越低越好。最高推理设置、无系统保护的: Figure 3 | FieldToFit redraw of point estimates stated with Figure 5; percent, lower is better. Maximum effort, simulated low-stakes tasks without system safeguards; no inferred sample sizes or production prevalence.
fields.基线行为测试不含第一方标准开发者提示；编码样本经过针对性挑选。: Baseline behavior without the standard first-party developer prompt; coding cases are deliberately selected.
fields.多项能力改善，但部分安全类别出现统计显著回归。: Several capabilities improve while some safety categories show statistically significant regressions.
fields.安全改善需要具体到版本、指标和保护层；既不抹去回归，也不把困难集失败率当日常风险: Safety gains depend on versions, metrics and safeguard layers: retain regressions without treating difficult-set failures as everyday risk.
fields.安全评估取最低部署推理设置，以接近大多数使用；能力评估取最高推理强度，以探查能力: Safety evaluations use the lowest deployed reasoning settings to reflect most usage; capability assessments use maximum reasoning effort to probe an upper bound. They cannot be merged into an unconditional capability table.
fields.少拒答与更安全是并列目标，可能存在权衡。敏感但正常的问题回答得更充分，不等于所有: Fewer unnecessary refusals and safer responses are parallel objectives with potential trade-offs. More complete answers to legitimate sensitive questions do not imply that all harmful requests succeed; fewer refusals alone do not prove safety.
fields.并列核对证据与口径: Check evidence and definitions in parallel
fields.底模行为与分类器等生产保护分别说明。: Describe base-model behavior separately from production protections such as classifiers.
fields.开放回答可能因更长而覆盖更多正向评分项，却未必更方便患者或临床读者使用。报告以: Longer open-ended answers can satisfy more positive rubric criteria without necessarily becoming more useful to patients or clinicians. The report uses 2,000 characters as the no-adjustment point. HealthBench Professional deducts 1.47 points per additional 500 characters, with a corresponding positive adjustment for shorter answers; other HealthBench variants use their own coefficients. Models are not given the penalty details in their prompts.
fields.总体安全判断改善，不代表每一类别都前进: A stronger overall safety judgment does not mean every category improves
fields.把版本身份、测量口径和部署保护逐层拆开: Separate version identity, measurement definitions and deployment protections
fields.报告列举人工复审、对抗测试及生产保护；不是同一组无保护测分。: The report describes manual review, adversarial testing and production protections, separate from unprotected model scores.
fields.报告发布时：ChatGPT 为十月版；Codex 与 Work 仍为九月版。: At report publication: October versions in ChatGPT, September versions in Codex and Work.
fields.报告同时公开回归和缓解，底模测分与部署保护须分别理解。: The report discloses regressions alongside mitigations; model scores and deployment protections need separate interpretation.
fields.报告时点的 ChatGPT 十月版与 Codex／Work 九月版对应图: Mapping at report time: October versions in ChatGPT and September versions in Codex and Work
fields.旧模型对照可能来自其后续版本，政策、评审器和数据也会演进。优先读本卡同表比较，避: Earlier-model comparisons can use later versions of those models, while policies, graders and datasets also evolve. Prefer within-card comparisons rather than combining numbers across cards.
fields.最高推理设置、模拟工作环境、无生产保护栈，主要为低风险情境。: Maximum reasoning effort, simulated work environments, no production safeguard stack, primarily low-stakes situations.
fields.有联网能力的评审模型分别检查回答级和断言级错误。: A web-enabled grading model checks response-level and claim-level factual errors separately.
fields.本报告针对十月版 Sol 与 Luna。: This report concerns the October Sol and Luna versions.
fields.本站未独立评估保护栈或实际用户风险。: FieldToFit has not independently evaluated the safeguard stack or real-user risk.
fields.模型能力和识别评测环境会影响结果；不是日常违规概率。: Model capability and evaluation awareness affect results; these are not everyday violation probabilities.
fields.用真实编码任务中的阻塞，以及缺少搜索工具的任务，评估最终答复是否披露限制。: Use blockers in realistic coding tasks and tasks lacking a search tool to evaluate whether final answers disclose limitations.
fields.系统卡描述的是特定部署版本，安全与能力评估还使用不同推理设置。: The card describes specific deployed versions, and safety and capability evaluations use different reasoning settings.
fields.越障、事实性与限制披露分别测量，不把某一失败率当作完整 Agent 可靠性。: Circumvention, factuality and limitation disclosure are measured separately; no single failure rate represents complete agent reliability.
fields.这些样本的失败率不代表日常流量发生率。: Failure rates on these cases do not estimate prevalence in everyday traffic.
fields.这份十月更新首先划定身份：报告发布时，ChatGPT 切换到十月版 GPT-6: The October update first establishes identity: at publication, ChatGPT moved to the October GPT-6 Sol and Luna versions while Codex and ChatGPT Work still used September versions. Shared product names do not make one card applicable to every surface. This mapping is retained at report time and does not replace subsequent updates.
fields.这是报告时点映射，不替代其他产品后续更新记录。: This is a mapping at report time, not a record of subsequent product updates.
fields.适用边界：底模评估、完整保护栈和真实生产发生率是三种证据，不能互相替代。: Boundary: base-model evaluation, the full safeguard stack and real-world prevalence are three distinct kinds of evidence.
fields.部署安全判断综合收益、回归性质和缓解措施。: Deployment safety judgment combines gains, the nature of regressions and mitigations.
fields.限制披露评估关注编码遇阻或缺少搜索工具时是否如实说明。报告注明 Luna 有 0: Disclosure evaluations test whether models acknowledge coding blockers or an unavailable search tool. The report excludes 0.25% of Luna samples that exited early due to infrastructure issues. This article retains that exclusion and does not guess values from charts not fully expanded.
fields.集合经过筛选，不推算普通用户的错误遭遇率。: Selected sets do not estimate error prevalence for ordinary users.
fields.首次整理所选 GPT-6 十月版系统卡，提供四结论、同号论述和三张本站重绘；保留: First analysis of the selected GPT-6 October system card, with four findings, matching arguments and three FieldToFit redraws, preserving source date, metric definitions, comparison versions and reproduction limits.

fields.Opus 5 及 4.8 仍有研究预览要求，不能将 5.5 的范围套到其他型号或: Opus 5 and 4.8 still have research-preview requirements. Do not extend 5.5 availability to other models or every cloud platform. FieldToFit has not tested it.

technical_map.question: MAI-Base-2：预训练计算节省，怎样变成可靠的大规模训练？

editorial: FieldToFit分析：这份报告最值得复用的是一条判断链——小实验是否控制了数据曝光，效率比较是否固定质量目标，系统实现是否把FLOPs优势变成实际进展。对训练团队，这是实验设计清单；对模型采用者，则是避免将训练论文直接翻译成产品承诺的方法。
路线连线并列组织需要同时检查的证据，不宣称某一模块独自造成全部增益。原文日期、本站核对及实际发表分开保存，后续若公开检查点或实质修订，再按新证据接续同一入口。
官方网页日期为 2026-10-15，未标编号修订；PDF入口参数v=2 不被解释为已确认的论文v2 或实质修订。本站 2026-10-17 核对，实际上站时间由发布记录维护。完整网页已深读，并交叉核对 13 页PDF中的定义与位置；原图尚未完成逐图视觉复核，本站不复制或数字化原图曲线。原文仅链接，三图为本站原创事实示意。

blocks.text: 把小模型训练得更久，并不一定模拟了大模型的处境。若小实验每次看到新数据，而最终训练要重复同一来源，小实验可能偏爱到了大规模才过拟合的配置。source scaling主动缩小小实验的独特样本池，同时保持各来源重复次数及TPP；它控制的是实验条件，不只是数据总量。

blocks.alt: 两种训练跨度均重复八次的source scaling示例
blocks.attribution: FieldToFit 本站原创事实示意，依据 Microsoft AI 官方技术文。
blocks.caption: 图 1｜本站示意。5T与 50T、八次重复取自作者示例，不是全部语料的实测配方；未数字化图 2 曲线。

evidence.locator: p4; Figure 2 and source scaling example

blocks.license: Graphics © FieldToFit; source facts: Microsoft AI, Frontier Pre-training at Microsoft AI, 2026-10-15.

items: 学习率与权重衰减联合搜索，作者改用LR和LR×WD坐标，再拟合训练步数与TPP的关系；这避免把两个耦合量当成彼此独立的旋钮。
这些经验关系先从小规模估计，再在中间规模验证。本站判断是：这种验证链比只公布一条最终训练曲线更能说明配方如何被选中，但不意味着其他数据和优化器可以照抄常数。

blocks.label: limit
blocks.text: 示例中的重复次数与经验超参数关系都有条件，不能当作通用训练默认值。

findings.summary: 预测大训练前，先让小实验的数据曝光与正则化条件可比较。
findings.title: 小模型要重复相似的数据，外推才更可信

blocks.text: 作者没有用最终两台不同大小模型的总训练计算直接宣布节省，而是在代码、问答、STEM和数学四项保留集上分别拟合BPB与训练FLOPs。以DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Base的BPB为目标，估计微软阶梯达到相同质量需要多少FLOPs，再与基线训练计算比较。BPB按字节度量，有助于跨tokenizer比较，但仍是指定文本保留集指标。

blocks.alt: 匹配基线BPB后比较所需训练FLOPs的定义示意
blocks.attribution: FieldToFit 本站原创事实示意，依据 Microsoft AI 官方技术文。
blocks.caption: 图 2｜本站示意，非实验曲线。4.2–12.3 倍为四项独立拟合结果的范围；已知最终终点纳入拟合，不是盲预测。
blocks.license: Graphics © FieldToFit; source facts: Microsoft AI, Frontier Pre-training at Microsoft AI, 2026-10-15.

items: 拟合纳入了已经训练完成的MAI-Base-2 终点，因此匹配点位于拟合模型范围内。这个口径比把它叫外推验证更准确，也应与图 2 用于预测终点的阶梯实验分开。
作者明确最终MAI-Base-2 实际使用的训练FLOPs比基线更多，并把配方效率投入更大的模型。效率提升和总支出下降是不同问题，报告未给出可推导API价格或完整训练账单的依据。

blocks.label: evidence
blocks.text: 这里的可审结论是“同一保留集质量目标下的估计训练计算更少”，不是最终模型总成本更低。

evidence.locator: pp4–5; Isolating modeling efficiency from compute

findings.summary: 先固定质量目标，再问训练配方需要多少计算。
findings.title: 4.2–12.3 倍是在等BPB处比较，不是实际账单

blocks.text: 微软称全层MoE此前在FLOPs上占优，却因实现开销在实际时间上不如隔层布局。新版把专家分组，为每个专家设固定token容量，用额外轮次处理溢出，并允许同组使用空闲容量；少分配内存可能意味着更多轮次，不是消除代价。通信与计算重叠、设备端元数据和批量归约减少了每专家开销。

blocks.alt: 固定内存多轮MoE，以及分母不同的 21% MFU与 89% goodput
blocks.attribution: FieldToFit 本站原创事实示意，依据 Microsoft AI 官方技术文。
blocks.caption: 图 3｜本站定性示意，不表示真实耗时比例。整次训练MFU 21%与goodput 89%分母不同，不能相减或当作同一利用率。
blocks.license: Graphics © FieldToFit; source facts: Microsoft AI, Frontier Pre-training at Microsoft AI, 2026-10-15.

items: MoE层MFU由 24%到 35%是局部实现结果；整次训练MFU为 21%，按每卡 2.5 PFLOPS归一，排除重计算和优化器FLOPs。goodput 89%则表示有训练进展的时间占比。
Muon需要完整矩阵做正交化，和分片优化器有张力；实现通过重分片及通信重叠处理。作者报告每步 165 ms、占 2.1%，理论 55 ms仍有差距，保留尾部等待、调度、负载不均和复制分配等解释。
激活梯度裁剪针对局部异常，避免一小部分样本牵连整批权重梯度；还帮助追到预处理截断许可头的错误。报告把方法收益与数据诊断连起来，但没有逐项隔离最终模型全部增益。

findings.summary: 计算上更稀疏的选择，也可能输给通信、碎片和尾部等待。
findings.title: 全层MoE能否划算，要同时看内存和真实训练时间

blocks.text: MAI-Base-2 以无编码器VLM方式原生预训练视觉。作者称独特训练token比上代约增 36%，视觉语料含 4.5T独特token，重复后视觉数据占 50T混合的 18%。独特样本量、重复曝光量和混合占比分母不同，本文保留各自单位，不反推未公布的数据明细。

items: 代码保留集是微软内部代码库；STEM、数学和问答集由供应商提供并进行去污染。它们能支持报告内BPB比较，不能替代开放任务集复现或你的业务质量评测。
Kimi K3、Qwen3.8 和MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL的可用对照已后训练，DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Base则是底座。作者已注明后训练可能影响结果，不将这张表写成统一纯预训练竞赛。
官方仍说模型在后训练，未来通过Foundry向可信合作伙伴许可权重是计划，不写成已公开下载或普遍可调用。训练数据知识截止为 2026-03，也不是报告发布日期。

blocks.label: limit
blocks.text: FieldToFit判断：这是一份有方法和工程细节的训练报告；可帮助判断实验设计，尚不能替代独立复现、应用评测或取得模型的实际条件。

evidence.locator: pp1–3 and pp11–13; Scaling Data and What’s next

findings.summary: 语料规模、基准结论和未来产品入口不能互相替代。
findings.title: 原生视觉训练已纳入，公开可用性仍需另看

technical_map.takeaway: 配方效率要连同可比较的实验条件和真实系统代价判断；少用FLOPs的能力，不自动等于最终训练账单更低。

items.title: MAI-Base-2：预训练计算节省，怎样变成可靠的大规模训练？

fields.16k GB200，38 天；MFU按每卡 2.5 PFLOPS归一。: 16k GB200 over 38 days; MFU normalized to 2.5 PFLOPS per GPU.
fields.2.8T总参数、80B激活、50T训练token；16k GB200、38 天。: 2.8T total and 80B active parameters; 50T training tokens; 16k GB200 GPUs over 38 days.
fields.4.2–12.3 倍是在等BPB处比较，不是实际账单: 4.2–12.3 times compares matched BPB, not actual bills
fields.4.5T与 18%分母不同，不能直接相除为独特语料占比。: 4.5T and 18% use different denominators; do not divide them into a unique-corpus share.
fields.FieldToFit 本站原创事实示意，依据 Microsoft AI 官方技术: Original factual diagram by FieldToFit, based on the official Microsoft AI technical article.
fields.FieldToFit分析：这份报告最值得复用的是一条判断链——小实验是否控制了数: FieldToFit analysis: the reusable decision chain asks whether small experiments control data exposure, efficiency comparisons fix a quality target, and systems turn FLOPs advantages into real progress. For training teams it guides experiments; for adopters it prevents turning a training paper into unsupported product promises.
fields.FieldToFit判断：这是一份有方法和工程细节的训练报告；可帮助判断实验设计: FieldToFit assessment: this report offers useful experimental and engineering detail, but cannot replace independent reproduction, application evaluation or actual access conditions.
fields.Kimi K3、Qwen3.8 和MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL的可用对照已后: Available Kimi K3, Qwen3.8 and MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL comparators are post-trained, while DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Base is a base checkpoint. Post-training may affect results, so the table is not a uniform base-pretraining contest.
fields.MAI-Base-2 以无编码器VLM方式原生预训练视觉。作者称独特训练toke: MAI-Base-2 uses native encoder-free VLM pre-training. Unique training tokens grow about 36% over the predecessor; the vision corpus has 4.5T unique tokens and, after repetition, contributes 18% of the 50T mixture. Unique volume, repeated exposure and mixture shares use different denominators; we do not infer undisclosed data details.
fields.MAI-Base-2：预训练计算节省，怎样变成可靠的大规模训练？: MAI-Base-2: turning pre-training efficiency into a reliable large-scale run
fields.MFU排除重计算和优化器FLOPs，goodput为有训练进展的时间比例。: MFU excludes recomputation and optimizer FLOPs; goodput is the fraction of time with training progress.
fields.MoE层MFU由 24%到 35%是局部实现结果；整次训练MFU为 21%，按每: MoE-layer MFU from 24% to 35% is a local implementation result. Whole-run MFU is 21%, normalized to 2.5 PFLOPS per GPU and excluding recomputation and optimizer FLOPs. Goodput 89% is the fraction of time with training progress.
fields.Muon分片重组与通信重叠；激活梯度裁剪抑制局部异常。: Muon resharding and communication overlap; activation-gradient clipping targets local outliers.
fields.Muon需要完整矩阵做正交化，和分片优化器有张力；实现通过重分片及通信重叠处理。: Muon needs full matrices for orthogonalization, creating tension with optimizer sharding. Resharding and communication overlap address this. The authors report 165 ms per step, or 2.1%, with a remaining gap to theoretical 55 ms due to stragglers, scheduling, imbalance and copies/allocations.
fields.source scaling缩小独特样本池，保持重复次数和TPP。: Source scaling restricts unique samples while preserving repetitions and TPP.
fields.不是实际总费用或API价格倍数。: Not a multiplier for actual total cost or API pricing.
fields.不是已核实的公开权重或通用API交付。: Not a verified public-weight or general API release.
fields.两种训练跨度均重复八次的source scaling示例: Source-scaling illustration with eight repetitions at two training horizons
fields.仍在后训练，未来可信合作伙伴权重许可不是当前开放下载。: Ongoing post-training and future partner weight licensing are not current public downloads.
fields.代码保留集是微软内部代码库；STEM、数学和问答集由供应商提供并进行去污染。它们: Held-out code uses Microsoft’s internal codebase; STEM, math and QA sets are vendor-commissioned and decontaminated. They support within-report BPB comparisons, not open-task reproduction or business-quality evaluation.
fields.作者MoE层MFU由 24%升至 35%，使全层MoE成为可用选择。: Authors raise MoE-layer MFU from 24% to 35%, enabling MoE in every layer.
fields.作者报告 4.2–12.3 倍FLOPs效率；最终大模型实际训练计算更多。: Authors report 4.2–12.3 times FLOPs efficiency; the final large model actually used more training compute.
fields.作者明确最终MAI-Base-2 实际使用的训练FLOPs比基线更多，并把配方效: The final MAI-Base-2 run explicitly uses more training FLOPs than the baseline, investing recipe efficiency in a larger model. Efficiency and lower total spending are different questions; the report does not establish API prices or a complete training bill.
fields.作者没有用最终两台不同大小模型的总训练计算直接宣布节省，而是在代码、问答、STE: Rather than declaring savings from total compute of two differently sized final models, the authors fit BPB against training FLOPs independently for held-out code, QA, STEM and math. They estimate the ladder compute needed to match DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Base BPB, then compare it with baseline training compute. BPB measures by byte and helps compare tokenizers, while remaining a metric for specified held-out text.
fields.作者结果未复现；部分基准私有、部分对照已后训练；模型仍在后训练。原文图表仅链接，: Author results are not reproduced; some benchmarks are private and some comparators post-trained. The model is still in post-training. Original charts are linked only; our diagrams illustrate facts rather than experimental curves.
fields.先固定质量目标，再问训练配方需要多少计算。: Fix the quality target before asking how much compute a recipe needs.
fields.全层MoE能否划算，要同时看内存和真实训练时间: Whether all-layer MoE pays off depends on memory and elapsed training time
fields.公开报告与可取得模型分开: Separate public reporting from model access
fields.分组固定专家容量，多轮dispatch／compute／collect，不丢弃溢: Group experts with fixed capacities and repeated dispatch / compute / collect, retaining overflow tokens.
fields.匹配基线BPB后比较所需训练FLOPs的定义示意: Definition diagram for training FLOPs needed to match baseline BPB
fields.原生视觉训练已纳入，公开可用性仍需另看: Native vision is included; public availability is a separate question
fields.四项保留集各拟合BPB与FLOPs，计算达到基线BPB所需算力。: Fit BPB versus FLOPs separately for four held-out sets, estimating compute to match baseline BPB.
fields.固定内存多轮MoE，以及分母不同的 21% MFU与 89% goodput: Fixed-memory multi-round MoE and distinct denominators for 21% MFU and 89% goodput
fields.固定内存，多轮处理溢出: Fixed memory with extra overflow rounds
fields.固定配方的L18 至L42 缩放阶梯；TPP为每激活参数训练token数。: A fixed-recipe L18 to L42 scaling ladder; TPP is training tokens per active parameter.
fields.图 1｜本站示意。5T与 50T、八次重复取自作者示例，不是全部语料的实测配方；: Figure 1 | Original diagram. 5T, 50T and eight repetitions come from the authors’ illustration, not a measured recipe for all data; Figure 2 curves are not digitized.
fields.图 2｜本站示意，非实验曲线。4.2–12.3 倍为四项独立拟合结果的范围；已知: Figure 2 | Original definition diagram, not an experimental curve. 4.2–12.3 times spans four independent fits; the known final endpoint is included, not a blind prediction.
fields.图 3｜本站定性示意，不表示真实耗时比例。整次训练MFU 21%与goodput: Figure 3 | Qualitative diagram, not measured timing proportions. Whole-run MFU 21% and goodput 89% have distinct denominators; do not subtract them or treat them as one utilization measure.
fields.在作者中间规模实验中优于此前启发式。: Outperforms earlier heuristics in the authors’ intermediate-scale tests.
fields.基线DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Base；拟合包含已知MAI-Base-2: DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Base baseline; fits include the known MAI-Base-2 endpoint.
fields.学习率与权重衰减联合搜索，作者改用LR和LR×WD坐标，再拟合训练步数与TPP的: Learning rate and weight decay are swept jointly using LR and LR×WD coordinates, then related to steps and TPP, avoiding treating coupled quantities as independent controls.
fields.官方仍说模型在后训练，未来通过Foundry向可信合作伙伴许可权重是计划，不写成: The official source says post-training is ongoing. Future licensing through Foundry to trusted partners is a plan, not public downloads or universal API availability. Training data has a 2026-03 knowledge cutoff, distinct from publication date.
fields.官方网页日期为 2026-10-15，未标编号修订；PDF入口参数v=2 不被解: The official web article is dated 2026-10-15 with no numbered revision. The PDF URL parameter v=2 is not treated as a verified paper v2 or substantive revision. Checked on 2026-10-17; the publication record maintains the actual site date. The complete web article was read and definitions and locations cross-checked in the 13-page PDF. Individual original charts have not completed visual review; no original curves are copied or digitized. Upstream text is linked only; three diagrams are original factual illustrations.
fields.容量可调，组内共享空闲容量，稳态目标一轮。: Capacity is tunable, with spare capacity shared inside a group; steady state targets one round.
fields.小实验保留数据重复规律: Preserve repetition patterns in small experiments
fields.小模型要重复相似的数据，外推才更可信: Small models need comparable data repetition for reliable scaling
fields.小规模搜索，中间规模验证；同时拟合dropout。: Small-scale sweeps with intermediate-scale validation; dropout is also fitted.
fields.已深读官方技术正文；再分发许可未确认，仅公开原文入口及本站原创分析。: The official technical text was read; redistribution rights are unverified, so publish source links and original analysis only.
fields.微软把数据重复规律、超参数外推和万卡系统放在同一条训练路线中。本文以四条结论、对: Microsoft connects repeated-data behavior, hyperparameter scaling and a large GPU system in one training recipe. Four findings, matching arguments and three original diagrams explain matched-quality compute, fixed-memory MoE and training utilization. FieldToFit has not reproduced the experiments.
fields.微软称全层MoE此前在FLOPs上占优，却因实现开销在实际时间上不如隔层布局。新: Microsoft says MoE in every layer previously won on FLOPs but lost on elapsed time to alternating layers. The new design groups experts with fixed token capacities, handles overflow in extra rounds and borrows spare capacity within a group. Less memory can mean more rounds; the tradeoff remains. Communication overlap, device metadata and batched reductions reduce per-expert overhead.
fields.把小模型训练得更久，并不一定模拟了大模型的处境。若小实验每次看到新数据，而最终训: Training a small model longer does not necessarily reproduce the large model’s conditions. If small runs keep seeing fresh examples while the final run repeats sources, the experiment can favor settings that overfit only at scale. Source scaling restricts unique samples in smaller runs while preserving source repetitions and TPP: it controls experimental conditions, not just volume.
fields.把训练方法、计算口径和工程条件一起读: Read the recipe, compute definition and engineering conditions together
fields.报告示例不是所有数据集的固定重复配方。: The illustration is not a fixed repetition recipe for every dataset.
fields.拟合纳入了已经训练完成的MAI-Base-2 终点，因此匹配点位于拟合模型范围内: The fit includes the already completed MAI-Base-2 endpoint, keeping matching points within the fitted family. Keep this distinct from Figure 2’s ladder used to predict the endpoint.
fields.按LR与LR×WD搜索，再拟合步数和TPP的经验关系。: Sweep LR and LR×WD, then fit empirical relations with steps and TPP.
fields.提供训练配方和工程证据，不足以判断全部产品任务。: Provides recipe and engineering evidence, not conclusions for every product task.
fields.改进解析、去重、主题分桶及多样性采样；无模型蒸馏的自建语料路线。: Improve parsing, deduplication, topic bins and diversity sampling, using an in-house organic-data route without model distillation.
fields.数据曝光、等质量计算量和万卡系统如何共同决定预训练结果: How data exposure, matched-quality compute and a large GPU system shape pre-training
fields.整次训练MFU 21%，goodput 89%；Muon每步 165 ms，占: Whole-run MFU 21%, goodput 89%; Muon takes 165 ms per step, or 2.1%.
fields.比较 2026-10 之前可用检查点，部分对照已经后训练。: Compare checkpoints available before 2026-10, including some post-trained alternatives.
fields.激活梯度裁剪针对局部异常，避免一小部分样本牵连整批权重梯度；还帮助追到预处理截断: Activation-gradient clipping targets local outliers instead of letting a few examples suppress the full batch gradient. It also helped trace a preprocessing bug that truncated a license header. This connects optimization with data diagnosis without isolating every contribution to the final model.
fields.独特数据与重复后混合比例分开: Separate unique data from repeated mixture shares
fields.独特训练token比上代约增 36%；视觉独特token 4.5T。: Unique training tokens grow about 36% over the predecessor; 4.5T unique vision tokens.
fields.示例中的重复次数与经验超参数关系都有条件，不能当作通用训练默认值。: Repetition counts and empirical hyperparameter relations are conditional, not universal training defaults.
fields.稀疏MoE底座，原生视觉预训练。: A sparse MoE base model with native visual pre-training.
fields.等BPB比较训练计算: Compare training compute at matched BPB
fields.算力利用率与有效进展时间分开: Separate compute utilization from progress time
fields.经验式依赖此配方，不是任意模型可照抄的常数。: The empirical laws depend on this recipe; constants are not universal defaults.
fields.网页明确日期，PDF入口参数不冒充编号修订；本站首次整理不是上游修订。: The web article dates publication; PDF URL parameters are not numbered revisions. This first local analysis is not an upstream revision.
fields.联合外推学习率与衰减: Scale learning rate and decay jointly
fields.计算上更稀疏的选择，也可能输给通信、碎片和尾部等待。: A sparser compute choice can still lose to communication, fragmentation and stragglers.
fields.评估使用保留集BPB；代码为内部代码库，其他任务向供应商委托。: Evaluate held-out BPB on an internal codebase and commissioned vendor sets for other tasks.
fields.语料规模、基准结论和未来产品入口不能互相替代。: Corpus scale, benchmark conclusions and future product access are distinct.
fields.路线连线并列组织需要同时检查的证据，不宣称某一模块独自造成全部增益。原文日期、本: Route edges organize evidence to check together, not causal attribution of every gain to one module. Source, check and site dates remain separate; later checkpoint access or substantive revisions can extend this stable entry.
fields.这些经验关系先从小规模估计，再在中间规模验证。本站判断是：这种验证链比只公布一条: The relations are estimated at small scale and validated at intermediate scale. Our assessment: this validation chain explains recipe selection better than a final training curve alone, while not making the constants transferable to other data and optimizers.
fields.这里的可审结论是“同一保留集质量目标下的估计训练计算更少”，不是最终模型总成本更: The reviewable claim is less estimated compute at a matched held-out quality target, not lower total cost for the final model.
fields.配方效率要连同可比较的实验条件和真实系统代价判断；少用FLOPs的能力，不自动等: Judge recipe efficiency with comparable experimental conditions and real system costs; needing fewer FLOPs does not automatically lower the final training bill.
fields.重复后的视觉数据占 50T训练混合 18%。: Repeated vision data accounts for 18% of the 50T training mixture.
fields.降低小规模实验偏好欠正则化配置的风险。: Reduces the risk of small experiments favoring under-regularized settings.
fields.预测大训练前，先让小实验的数据曝光与正则化条件可比较。: Make data exposure and regularization comparable before predicting a large run.
fields.预训练已完成，仍在后训练。: Pre-training is complete; post-training is ongoing.
fields.额外轮次增加工作量；层级MFU不等于整次训练MFU。: Extra rounds add work; layer MFU is not whole-run MFU.
fields.首次整理所选MAI-Base-2 技术文，提供四结论、同号论述、三张原创事实图，: First analysis of the selected MAI-Base-2 technical article: four findings, matching arguments and three original factual diagrams distinguish fitted BPB efficiency, actual training compute, MFU and goodput.

reading_materials.body:
# AG-UI: The Agent-User Interaction Protocol AG-UI is an open, lightweight, event-based protocol that standardizes how AI agents connect to user-facing applications. Built for simplicity and flexibility, it enables seamless integration between AI agents, real time user context, and user interfaces. ---

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@ag-ui/core?label=Version&color=6963ff&logo=npm&logoColor=white)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@ag-ui/core) ![MIT](https://img.shields.io/github/license/copilotkit/copilotkit?color=%236963ff&label=License) ![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1379082175625953370?logo=discord&logoColor=%23FFFFFF&label=Discord&color=%236963ff) Join our Discord →     Read the Docs →     Go to the AG-UI Dojo →     Follow us → ## 🚀 Getting Started Create a new AG-UI application in seconds: ```bash npx create-ag-ui-app my-agent-app ```

Useful Links:

- [The AG-UI Dojo](https://dojo.ag-ui.com/) - [Build AG-UI-powered applications(Quickstart)](https://docs.ag-ui.com/quickstart/applications) - [Build new AG-UI framework integrations (Quickstart)](https://go.copilotkit.ai/agui-contribute) - [Book a call to discuss an AG-UI integration with a new framework](https://calendly.com/markus-copilotkit/ag-ui) - [Join the Discord Community](https://discord.gg/Jd3FzfdJa8) ## What is AG-UI? AG-UI is an open, lightweight, event-based protocol for agent-human interaction, designed for simplicity & flexibility: - During agent executions, agent backends **emit events _compatible_ with one of AG-UI's ~16 standard event types** - Agent backends can **accept one of a few simple AG-UI compatible inputs** as arguments **AG-UI includes a flexible middleware layer** that ensures compatibility across diverse environments: - Works with **any event transport** (SSE, WebSockets, webhooks, etc.) - Allows for **loose event format matching**, enabling broad agent and app interoperability It also ships with a **reference HTTP implementation** and **default connector** to help teams get started fast. [Learn more about the specs →](https://go.copilotkit.ai/ag-ui-introduction) ## Why AG-UI? AG-UI was developed based on real-world requirements and practical experience building in-app agent interactions. ## Where does AGUI fit in the agentic protocol stack? AG-UI is complementary to the other 2 top agentic protocols - MCP gives agents tools - A2A allows agents to communicate with other agents - AG-UI brings agents into user-facing applications
## 🚀 Features - 💬 Real-time agentic chat with streaming - 🔄 Bi-directional state synchronization - 🧩 Generative UI and structured messages - 🧠 Real-time context enrichment - 🛠️ Frontend tool integration - 🧑‍💻 Human-in-the-loop collaboration ## 🛠 Supported Integrations AG-UI was born from CopilotKit's initial **partnership** with LangChain and CrewAI - and brings the incredibly popular agent-user-interactivity infrastructure to the wider agentic ecosystem. **1st party** = the platforms that have AG‑UI built in and provide documentation for guidance. ## Frameworks | Framework | fields.为什么值得看：前端可以区分哪条消息来自哪个子任务，显示等待用户批准、取消或完成状: Why is it worth watching: The front-end can distinguish which message comes from which sub-task, and display the status of waiting for user approval, cancellation or completion; there is no need to just stuff all outputs into the same chat bubble.
fields.具体材料：JSON Schema定义字段，协议正文说明事件顺序与错误行为；Typ: Materials: JSON Schema defines fields; the protocol describes event ordering and error behavior. TypeScript, Python and .NET have corresponding migration guidance.
fields.升级边界：协议兼容不等于SDK零改动。TS校验器入口迁移、自定义字段转metad: Upgrade boundary: protocol compatibility does not imply zero SDK changes. The TS validator entry point moves, custom fields move to metadata and Python JSON Patch uses typed objects. Transitional compatibility features also have expiry rules. The repository is MIT-licensed; FieldToFit has not run integration tests.

technical_map.question: Muse Spark Open：开放模型的成绩，怎样才算可比较？

editorial: FieldToFit分析：开放权重提高了部署与修改的控制权，但不能替你完成设备、任务和权限验证。先选择自己的验收样本，再用作者成绩决定值得测试什么。
对照来源、框架和量尺，是把模型发布读成采用方案的关键。本文的并行连线仅组织需要同时核对的证据，不主张模型训练的因果继承。
方法PDF仅标 2026-10；模型卡与公告明确模型发布日 2026-10-15。本站核对日 2026-10-16 与实际网站发表分别保存。无独立修订号；完整安全评估报告仍待发布。原文与原图仅链接，三图为本站原创重绘，不声称复现、价格降低或全场景安全。

blocks.text: Muse Spark Open把编码、工具使用和多模态输入放在同一开放检查点中。MoE只激活部分专家，意味着每个token的计算路径较稀疏；本站据此提醒：不要把激活参数直接当成需要下载、存储或驻留的全部权重。

items: 模型卡列出 816B总参数、42B激活，以及文字／图像／视频／音频输入和文字输出；不是一个文字输出之外的通用生成套件。
NVFP4 至少 700GB显存、BF16 至少 2TB是作者列出的运行要求；双M5 Ultra演示也依赖大容量统一内存，不能转述成普通个人电脑均可部署。

blocks.label: limit
blocks.text: FieldToFit判断：选型前先确认机器容量、精度、框架与任务，再讨论是否适合本地运行。

findings.summary: 开放的是配置和部署选择，硬件门槛仍要看完整检查点与精度。
findings.title: 激活 42B，不代表只需存 42B权重

blocks.text: 两个数来自不同任务系统。OSWorld让Agent操作完整桌面，检查最终状态；MCP-Atlas让Agent调用服务工具，先评价声明覆盖，再按阈值判断通过。把它们并排展示有助于辨认能力范围，合成一个平均数却会抹掉测量意义。

MCP-Atlas的 1000 是基准总任务量；89.2%的实际公开／私有split分母在该方法说明中未单独明确。本次保留缺口，不反推通过了多少条。

items.title: Muse Spark Open：开放模型的成绩，怎样才算可比较？

fields.361 任务、排除Google Drive、每题 4 次、最多 200 步。: 361 tasks, Google Drive excluded, 4 attempts each, up to 200 steps.
fields.80.4 与 89.2，不能平均成一个Agent成功率: 80.4 and 89.2 are not one average agent success rate
fields.816B 总参数／42B 激活；推理上下文 1M；作者评测采用 xhigh。: 816B total / 42B active; 1M inference context; author evaluations use xhigh.
fields.AA 指数取 2026-10-07；编程任务采用不同首选Agent框架。: The AA index uses 2026-10-07 data; coding tasks use different preferred agent harnesses.
fields.FieldToFit 本站原创重绘；依据 Meta 的 Muse Spark O: Original FieldToFit redraw based on Meta’s official Muse Spark Open materials.
fields.FieldToFit分析：开放权重提高了部署与修改的控制权，但不能替你完成设备、: FieldToFit analysis: open weights increase deployment and modification control without performing device, task or permission validation for you. Define acceptance samples first, then use author scores to decide what deserves testing.
fields.FieldToFit判断：用你自己的任务集合验证完成质量、失败恢复与资源占用，再: FieldToFit assessment: evaluate completion quality, failure recovery and resource use on your own tasks before replacing the existing system.
fields.FieldToFit判断：选型前先确认机器容量、精度、框架与任务，再讨论是否适合: FieldToFit assessment: confirm capacity, precision, runtime and tasks before deciding whether local deployment fits.
fields.GUI奖励与MCP任务通过率采用不同分母、规则和工具。: GUI reward and MCP task pass rate use different denominators, rules and tools.
fields.GUI子集的平均奖励: Mean reward on a GUI subset
fields.MCP-Atlas的 1000 是基准总任务量；89.2%的实际公开／私有spl: The 1000 MCP-Atlas tasks describe the benchmark. This methodology does not separately identify the public/private split denominator underlying 89.2%. We retain that gap rather than infer how many tasks passed.
fields.MCP任务按覆盖阈值判通过: MCP tasks pass a claim-coverage threshold
fields.MoE Transformer 与感知编码器，原生多模态输入、文字输出。: A MoE Transformer and perception encoder accept multimodal input and return text.
fields.Muse Spark Open把编码、工具使用和多模态输入放在同一开放检查点中。: Muse Spark Open combines coding, tool use and multimodal input in one open checkpoint. MoE activates only some experts, making each token’s computation sparse. Our reading is to avoid equating active parameters with all weights to download, store or keep resident.
fields.Muse Spark Open提供可自托管的多模态检查点；判断是否适合采用，应同: Muse Spark Open offers a self-hostable multimodal checkpoint. Adoption requires task/scoring details, provenance, hardware and licensing; rankings or local speedups are not business guarantees.
fields.Muse Spark Open：开放模型的成绩，怎样才算可比较？: Muse Spark Open: what makes open-model scores comparable?
fields.NVFP4 至少 700GB显存、BF16 至少 2TB是作者列出的运行要求；双: The author lists at least 700GB VRAM for NVFP4 and 2TB for BF16; the two M5 Ultra demonstration also relies on large unified memory. This is not support for every ordinary personal computer.
fields.NVIDIA／AMD内核；端到端结果明确为AMD MI350。: NVIDIA / AMD kernels; the end-to-end result specifically uses AMD MI350;
fields.OSWorld与MCP-Atlas的任务范围、工具和评分方式对照: OSWorld and MCP-Atlas task scope, tools and scoring
fields.OSWorld为 361 任务子集，排除Google Drive依赖任务；只有G: OSWorld uses a 361-task subset excluding Google Drive dependencies, GUI only, at most 200 steps and four-attempt averaging. These are concrete constraints, not coverage of every desktop application.
fields.不是任意电脑任务的成功概率；Kimi为自报，坐标约定也不同。: Not a success probability for arbitrary desktop tasks; Kimi is self-reported and coordinate conventions differ.
fields.不能相乘、推广到所有硬件或推导API价格。: Do not multiply them, generalize to all hardware or infer API prices.
fields.两个数来自不同任务系统。OSWorld让Agent操作完整桌面，检查最终状态；M: The values come from different task systems. OSWorld asks an agent to operate a desktop and checks final state. MCP-Atlas evaluates tool tasks through claim coverage and a pass threshold. Showing both identifies coverage; averaging them removes their measurement meaning.
fields.主流开放模型的Agent评测与采用边界: Agent evaluation and adoption boundaries for a mainstream open model
fields.任务成绩不直接替代现场验证: Task scores do not replace application validation
fields.作者评测未复现；报告月份精度保留。MCP本行split分母未明确，第三方框架不同: Author evaluations were not reproduced; preserve month precision. The MCP score’s split denominator is unspecified, third-party harnesses differ and full safety reporting is pending.
fields.保留原始日期精度；本站阅读和发布不冒充上游修订。: Retain source date precision; local reading and site publication are not upstream revisions.
fields.先核对量尺，再决定是否采用: Check the measure before choosing the model
fields.先看成绩出处与Agent框架，再看名次: Read score provenance and agent harnesses before ranks
fields.六类评测的成绩来源和关键配置对照表: Provenance and configuration table for six evaluations
fields.内核 1.03 至 3.95 倍与AMD MI350 端到端 3%的口径示意: Scope diagram for 1.03–3.95× kernel gains and AMD MI350 end-to-end 3%
fields.内核提速，不自动变成整条工作流同幅提速: Kernel speedups do not guarantee equal workflow gains
fields.内部运行、榜单快照与厂商自报不能被写成同一场统一测试。: Internal runs, leaderboard snapshots and provider reports are not one uniform evaluation.
fields.原文仅链接，本站图形为原创事实重绘: Link upstream text only; FieldToFit diagrams are original factual redraws
fields.发布文章把Helion内核优化与整体推理收益分开报告。FieldToFit保留这: The launch post separates Helion kernel optimization from whole-inference gains. We preserve that distinction: workflows include operations outside those kernels, so a maximum local multiplier does not promise the same gain for a machine, every task or API pricing.
fields.发布配置与评测出处分别核对: Check release configuration and evaluation provenance separately
fields.只允许截图与GUI操作，按最终虚拟机状态给奖励。: Screenshot and GUI actions only; final VM state determines reward.
fields.可自托管或使用第三方API。: Self-hosting or third-party APIs are available.
fields.图 1｜本站重绘。MCP基准总量不等于已核实的本行成绩分母；两列不能合成总准确率: Figure 1 | FieldToFit redraw. Benchmark size is not a verified denominator for the reported MCP score; the columns do not form an overall accuracy.
fields.图 2｜本站重绘。AA指数与部分工作任务数据使用 10 月 7 日快照；未报告不: Figure 2 | FieldToFit redraw. The AA index and some work-task figures use the 10/7 snapshot; unavailable results do not mean zero capability.
fields.图 3｜本站示意，非同尺度统计柱图。两个声明的硬件与路径范围不同，不能相乘或推导: Figure 3 | FieldToFit diagram, not a common-scale statistical bar chart. Hardware and path scopes differ; do not multiply the claims or infer an API price cut.
fields.基准含 1000 任务、公开／私有各 500，36 个服务与 220 工具。: The benchmark has 1000 tasks, public / private splits of 500 each, 36 servers and 220 tools.
fields.完整安全报告待发布；微调或量化后的结果不自动继承原检查点结论。: Full safety reporting is pending; modified or quantized models do not automatically inherit the released checkpoint’s results.
fields.对照来源、框架和量尺，是把模型发布读成采用方案的关键。本文的并行连线仅组织需要同: Checking sources, harnesses and measures turns a release into an adoption assessment. Parallel links organize evidence to check together; they do not assert causal training inheritance.
fields.将权重、工具权限、运行框架和业务评测作为整体。: Treat weights, tool permissions, runtime and task evaluation as a system.
fields.局部优化、端到端收益、许可与安全是不同采用条件。: Kernel optimization, end-to-end gain, licensing and safety are separate adoption conditions.
fields.局部内核与完整路径分开: Separate kernels from the whole path
fields.已实际读取并核对来源位置；未确认原文再分发许可，公开原创分析、事实示意和原文链接: Actually read and checked against source locations; text redistribution rights are unverified, so publish original analysis, factual diagrams and source links.
fields.并列量尺：MCP阈值通过率: Parallel measure: MCP thresholded pass rate
fields.开放权重让部署与修改更可控，但选模型仍要读清实验条件。本文以四条结论、同号论述和: Open weights offer more control over deployment and modification, but model selection still requires reading the experimental conditions. Four findings, matching arguments and three original diagrams separate hardware requirements, two agent-scoring rules, score provenance and kernel versus end-to-end gains. FieldToFit has not reproduced the author’s evaluations.
fields.开放的是配置和部署选择，硬件门槛仍要看完整检查点与精度。: Open weights expand configuration and deployment choices; requirements still depend on the full checkpoint and precision.
fields.性能声明与采用条件同时核对: Check performance claims alongside adoption conditions
fields.方法PDF仅标 2026-10；模型卡与公告明确模型发布日 2026-10-15: The methodology PDF gives only 2026-10; the card and announcement date the model release 2026-10-15. The 2026-10-16 check and actual site publication are recorded separately. No independent revision number is given; the full safety evaluation report is pending. Link original text and artwork only; three diagrams are original FieldToFit redraws. No claim of replication, lower prices or universal safety is made.
fields.方法文档的价值在于保留每行证据链。作者采用较高推理档位，但也说明第三方工具与系统: The methodology preserves provenance for each row. It uses high reasoning settings but acknowledges that third-party tools and system prompts were not individually optimized. Our assessment is that the results can narrow choices without isolating the contributions of weights, inference budget and agent engineering.
fields.未针对第三方模型逐一优化，不能把差距全部归因于权重。: Third-party setups were not individually optimized; gaps cannot be attributed solely to weights.
fields.本文件未单独明确该成绩所用split的分母，不把 1000 当已确认分母。: The document does not separately identify the split denominator for that score; 1000 is not a confirmed denominator.
fields.模型卡列出 816B总参数、42B激活，以及文字／图像／视频／音频输入和文字输出: The card lists 816B total and 42B active parameters, text / image / video / audio input and text output; it is not a general generator of all those output modalities.
fields.模型卡报告 80.4；是平均奖励的百分制展示。: The card reports 80.4, a percentage-scale presentation of mean reward.
fields.模型卡给出 89.2% 任务通过率。: The card gives an 89.2% task pass rate.
fields.每行成绩先确认出处与框架: Check provenance and harness for each row
fields.每项声明记 0／0.5／1，平均覆盖至少 0.75 才算任务通过。: Each claim scores 0 / 0.5 / 1; average coverage at least 0.75 passes a task.
fields.比较时至少保留：任务集合、工具权限、尝试次数、评分规则和结果来源。: Preserve at least the task set, tool permissions, attempts, scoring rule and result source in a comparison.
fields.激活 42B，不代表只需存 42B权重: 42B active does not mean storing only 42B weights
fields.激活参数不是显存要求；量化、框架和许可另核。: Active parameters are not a VRAM requirement; check quantization, frameworks and licensing separately.
fields.编程表中的首选框架包含Muse Code、Claude Code和Kimi Co: Preferred coding harnesses include Muse Code, Claude Code and Kimi Code. Comparing complete systems is useful, but their differences cannot all be assigned to the base model.
fields.缺值保留缺值，不补零；不同来源不等同统一实跑。: Missing values stay missing, not zero; mixed sources are not one uniform rerun.
fields.自定义Muse许可要求署名等条件；部分MaaS业务还有单独商业门槛。不能把开放权: The custom Muse license has attribution and other conditions, with a separate commercial threshold for some MaaS businesses. Open weights do not mean unrestricted use in every commercial context.
fields.自定义许可；NVFP4 至少 700GB显存、BF16 至少 2TB，作者所列配: Custom license; author-listed NVFP4 minimum 700GB VRAM and BF16 2TB.
fields.评测方法分别记录内部运行、官方榜单和提供方自报。: The methodology separates internal runs, official leaderboards and provider self-reports.
fields.运行优化独立于成绩排名: Runtime optimization is separate from score rankings
fields.遇到自报或缺值，保留来源身份和未知项；不要补零、拼接旧卡分数，或把报告中的快照改: For self-reports and missing values, preserve provenance and unknowns. Do not fill zeros, splice old-card scores or relabel the document’s snapshot as today’s live ranking.
fields.部署可控性增加，但不能保证你的任务稳定完成。: Deployment control improves without guaranteeing reliable completion of your tasks.
fields.量化、下游修改和工具接入可能改变质量或风险。模型卡建议应用自己的防护与不可逆操作: Quantization, downstream modifications and tool integration may change quality or risk. The card recommends application guardrails and confirmation for irreversible actions. Detailed safety reporting is pending; current materials are not proof of universal safety.
fields.首次整理所有者选中的Muse Spark Open材料：四结论、同号论述和三张原: First analysis of owner-selected Muse Spark Open materials: four findings, matching arguments and three original diagrams; keep a question and URL distinct from Muse Wonder.

fields.Claude Code 2.1.300：修复压缩后的恢复，Python SDK更: Claude Code 2.1.300: compaction recovery fixes and a Python SDK CLI update
fields.Claude Code与Python Agent SDK分别于北京时间 10 月: Claude Code and Python Agent SDK were released at 02:24 and 03:25 Beijing time on 10/15. The changes maintain session recovery, MCP and execution boundaries rather than model capabilities.
fields.Python0.2.167 发行说明仅明确捆绑CLI2.1.300；不能推定Ty: The Python0.2.167 release only explicitly updates its bundled CLI2.1.300; do not infer a matching TypeScript release. SDK authentication, licensing and third-party-product restrictions remain; FieldToFit has not regression-tested runtime behavior.
fields.修复部分headless／Agent SDK恢复时丢失近期消息、压缩摘要或带回旧: Fixes some headless/Agent SDK resumes that lost recent messages or compaction summaries, or restored old history. One fix applies only to compactions created from this version onward; it does not promise recovery of every older record.

fields.0.163.0 为 openai/codex 正式发行，发布时间换算为北京时间: The official openai/codex 0.163.0 release was published at 05:30 Beijing time on 10-16. Use /config to search and change supported preferences, with restart guidance where needed. Follow-ups can steer immediately, and interruption stops active Code Mode cells and nested calls. /keymap configures a leader key, defaulting to Ctrl+X; /daemon restarts managed servers after warning about affected work. Resume restores permissions and network approvals while respecting overrides and managed policy, and the proxy checks permission before DNS resolution. Packages no longer bundle patched zsh, with migration notices for retired shell flags. This is a stable release, not an alpha; FieldToFit has not installed or tested it.

technical_map.question: Nano Banana 2.1：图像偏好、事实性与编辑一致性要分开看

editorial: FieldToFit判断：这份卡最有价值的是拆开指标，而不是提供一个“最强图像模型”的总答案。偏好、事实性与编辑任务分别决定它能支持哪些判断。
采用建议：先列自己的信息图、产品、人物与多轮编辑样本，再分别检查文字、事实、身份和修改保留；Thinking收益应连同实际费用和等待时间另测。本建议未被本站运行验证。
来源与修订：官网页面 2026-10-06，PDF版本 2026 年 10 月，本站核对 2026-10-15，网站发表时间由真实发布回执记录。8 页全文已读，原文只链接；三张图为本站重绘，均引物理第 5 页。

blocks.text: 模型卡把图像质量拆成文生图、编辑与多轮场景，并用回归集合观察旧版常见用法。它没有把所有指标合成一个通用图像正确率。理解这份报告，首先要保留评分者与任务的差别。

items: 人工偏好：总偏好Elo依次为 2.1Thinking1050±14、2.1NoThinking1015±13、Nano Banana2Thinking990±7、Nano BananaPro935±8；信息图设计为 1048±17、1001±17、961±12、912±12。
自动事实性：四种配置分别 0.521、0.328、0.179、0.265，来自单边AutoRater。不能将其与Elo相加、平均，也不能直接说Thinking让实际业务准确率达到 52.1%。
不确定性：重绘保留±范围，但卡没有交代足够的样本量、区间置信水平或AutoRater校准细节，不能补造显著性结论。

blocks.label: evidence
blocks.text: 报告支持“这些评测中的偏好与事实性评分改善”，尚不支持“任意信息图都可免核对”或“所有用户工作流同幅提高”。

evidence.locator: Physical p5; interpretation with stated conditions

findings.summary: Thinking在作者偏好表中较高，但Elo与事实性AutoRater不是同一种量尺。
findings.title: 更受偏好不等于事实更准确，两套评分必须分开

blocks.text: 编辑的难点并不只有画面是否好看，还包括修改后人物、产品或多个参考元素能否保持。卡将这些问题拆开，比用一个编辑总分更有助于读者判断自己的任务是否被覆盖。

items: 单人物一致性：Thinking1028±14，NoThinking1021±14；两项原表范围明显重叠，不能仅用较高点估计宣布确定优势。
多人物一致性：Thinking1106±14、NoThinking1068±14；多参考编辑为 1066±22、1041±20。它们是不同任务，不能横向平均成一致性成功率。
其他行：一般编辑、产品、风格化和遮罩／涂鸦各有比较结果。卡仍承认角色不一致、部分指令未遵循、涂鸦残留和输入姿态固着。

blocks.license: Graphics © FieldToFit; original data: Google DeepMind Nano Banana 2.1 model card.

blocks.label: limit
blocks.text: 用于品牌人物、产品或多轮编辑时，仍应逐图核对身份、文字、遮罩边缘与空间关系；这里是建议检查的项目，不是本站完成的性能测试。

evidence.locator: Physical p5; interpretation with stated conditions

findings.summary: 单人物、多人物与多参考图应逐行对比；较高点估计不等于每项差异都显著。
findings.title: 编辑改善要按任务看，人物一致性仍非保证

blocks.text: 模型基于Gemini3.6Flash，可接收文本与图像并输出图像与文本。这说明基础依赖和接口形态，但报告没有提供足够信息来独立还原图像训练配方、参数规模或Thinking内部算法。

items: 输入：文本与图像，上下文窗口最多 1M token。输出：图像 4K token、文本 64K token；不把 4K token解释为 4K像素分辨率，也不由这些数字推算生成时长。
采用：卡列GeminiApp、AIStudio、GeminiAPI、SearchAIMode、Ads、Flow与Stitch。渠道名称不保证每种账户、地域或工作流使用同一型号与配额，具体API标识和价格仍需采用时确认。
本地工具关系：本站已审ComfyUI0.40.0 加入伙伴节点。节点上架、作者模型首发和实际账户可调用是三个不同事件，不能互相代替。

evidence.locator: Physical p2; interpretation with stated conditions

findings.summary: 输入最多 1M，图像输出 4K指token；官方列出渠道仍需核对账户与地区。
findings.title: 上下文和输出规格不能代替画质与可得性

blocks.text: 卡把图像质量局限、人工红队和前沿安全分开陈述。三类证据回答的问题不同：对偏好测试得分更高，不会自动消除幻觉、拒绝行为或被滥用的风险。

items: 质量与可靠性：小字可能模糊，长段文字、角色一致性、左右定位与 3D／世界知识事实性仍有限，偶有缓慢或超时。知识截止依赖基础模型，部分领域可能更早。
人工红队：作者称儿童安全满足其上线阈值，一般内容安全与部分比较相近或改善。这是作者自己的评估和阈值，不是独立安全认证。
前沿风险：卡依赖Gemini3.1Pro与Gemini3.7Flash结果，并据未见实质新能力判断 2.1 不太可能达到相关阈值。应写成基于其他模型的推断，不能声称 2.1 已独立重跑全部测试或“零风险”。

blocks.label: limit
blocks.text: 作者报告与本站分析都不能替代具体业务的验证。对需要事实正确、身份一致或合规审核的图片，保留原始依据和人工复核。

evidence.locator: Physical p7; interpretation with stated conditions

findings.summary: 图像质量仍有限；前沿安全部分依赖其他型号评测，不是本模型的完整独立认证。
findings.title: 已知失败和安全推断必须与成绩一起保留

fields.深读 8 页官方模型卡，以四条结论和三张本站重绘区分图像偏好、事实性、编辑一致性: Read the 8-page official model card through four findings and three original redraws separating image preference, factuality, editing consistency and adoption limits. Thinking scores higher in several author evaluations, but Elo is not correctness and AutoRater is not business accuracy. Small text, character consistency and spatial errors still need human review.
fields.独立编辑行沿用人工偏好口径: Independent editing rows use human-preference scoring
fields.用于品牌人物、产品或多轮编辑时，仍应逐图核对身份、文字、遮罩边缘与空间关系；这里: For brand characters, products or multi-turn edits, inspect identity, text, mask boundaries and spatial relations in each image. These are suggested checks, not performance tests completed by FieldToFit.
fields.结果只对应表内任务，不构成所有模型的统一榜单。: Results apply to the table’s tasks, not a universal model ranking.
fields.编辑成绩不取消一致性与安全边界: Editing scores do not remove consistency or safety limits
fields.编辑改善要按任务看，人物一致性仍非保证: Editing gains depend on the task; character consistency is not guaranteed
fields.编辑的难点并不只有画面是否好看，还包括修改后人物、产品或多个参考元素能否保持。卡: Editing concerns more than appearance: characters, products and multiple references must survive changes. Separate rows help readers judge coverage of their own task better than one editing total.
fields.自动事实性：四种配置分别 0.521、0.328、0.179、0.265，来自单: Automated factuality: the four settings score 0.521, 0.328, 0.179 and 0.265 with a single-sided AutoRater. Do not add or average these with Elo, or claim Thinking achieves 52.1% business accuracy.
fields.规格与成绩并列，不由上下文容量推出质量: Specifications accompany scores; context capacity does not imply quality
fields.角色仍可能不一致；不能以点估计证明所有差异显著。: Character inconsistency remains; point estimates do not establish universal statistical significance.
fields.评测口径与生成结果对应，不构造训练因果: Evaluation definitions accompany generation results without a training-causality claim
fields.质量与可靠性：小字可能模糊，长段文字、角色一致性、左右定位与 3D／世界知识事实: Quality and reliability: small text can be blurry; long text, character consistency, left/right location and 3D/world-knowledge factuality remain limited, with occasional slowness or timeouts. Knowledge cutoff depends on the base model and may be earlier in some domains.
fields.输入上下文最多 1M；图像 4K输出token、文本 64K输出token。: Input context up to 1M; image output 4K tokens and text output 64K tokens.
fields.输入最多 1M，图像输出 4K指token；官方列出渠道仍需核对账户与地区。: Input is up to 1M, while image output 4K means tokens; listed channels still require account and region checks.
fields.输入：文本与图像，上下文窗口最多 1M token。输出：图像 4K token: Input: text and images with context up to 1M tokens. Output: images 4K tokens and text 64K tokens. Do not interpret 4K tokens as 4K pixel resolution or infer generation duration from these figures.
fields.采用建议：先列自己的信息图、产品、人物与多轮编辑样本，再分别检查文字、事实、身份: Adoption proposal: define your own infographic, product, character and multi-turn samples, then check text, facts, identity and preserved edits separately. Measure Thinking gains alongside actual cost and wait time; FieldToFit has not run this proposed validation.
fields.采用：卡列GeminiApp、AIStudio、GeminiAPI、Search: Access: the card lists GeminiApp, AIStudio, GeminiAPI, SearchAIMode, Ads, Flow and Stitch. Channel names do not guarantee the same model or quota for every account, region or workflow; verify exact API identifiers and prices at adoption.
fields.首次整理所选模型卡：四结论、同号论述与三张本站重绘，保留原始指标、日期精度和已知: First analysis of the selected card: four findings, matching arguments and three original redraws, retaining metric definitions, date precision and known limitations.

technical_map.question: Gemini 4 Argon：长任务成绩领先在哪，哪些比较并不等价？

editorial: FieldToFit分析：最有用的读法，是先确定任务，再检查成绩的样本、工具与预算，最后给不可逆行动设权限与人工批准。主流模型品牌与一个高分都不能替代业务任务的验收。
可以为自己的工作流建立小测试：长资料的引用定位、代码修改后的完整测试、超时后的接续，以及输出中的不确定性提示。记录成功与失败、用时和token费用，避免只挑最好一次。
日期分开维护：模型 9 月 30 日发布、10 月 13 日扩大开放；本模型卡只知 2026 年 10 月；本站核对与文章发表在 10 月 14 日。后续只有真实新证据或实质修订才更新，不由无变化检查刷新公开日期。

blocks.text: 模型卡明确Argon不是旧模型的微调版本，而是新的稀疏MoE模型。多模态输入和多步推理训练使它可以覆盖较复杂工作流；但公开卡没有给参数总量、训练数据各类占比或完整训练预算，不能补出机制细节。

items: 容量：输入与输出合计最多 1M token；不是输入 1M再额外输出 1M。
测试：最多 128K组 650 题；256K至 1M组 200 题，BFS F1 分别 99.7%／84.2%。两组题不同，不能由 15.5 个百分点差值推算同一任务的失败增加。
产品：模型卡仍列幻觉、延迟／超时与 2026 年 3 月知识截止。检索、引用核对和任务终态验证仍有价值。

items: Vals Index：Argon 68.9%，GPT-6 Astra 63.1%，Fable 5.1 65.8%，Opus 5.5 67.0%；本行可描述为表内领先。
FrontierSWE v2：Argon 55.0%，Astra 65.5%；Terminal-Bench 4.0：Argon 57.4%，Opus 5.5 为 66.4%；本行不能写Argon全面领先。
PostTrainBench：Argon 45.3%，Opus 5.5 为 49.3%。共享硬件和框架改善可比性，但仍只是四个基础模型与七个基准的加权结果。

blocks.text: 方法文档默认最高thinking、单次尝试，且小基准平均多次试验以降低波动。其他厂商通常引用自报结果，能取得时用最大推理设置，否则用最佳可得结果；这不是一场统一实验。

items: PostTrainBench v1.1：全部模型由Google复测，OpenCode、单NVIDIA H100、10 小时预算；数据与权重范围必须一起写。
OSWorld 2.0：离线子集部分分，3 次运行取最大，每次单次尝试；默认 1080p、最多 500 步，Gemini CUA框架与并行批量工具调用。69.2%不能直接称完整任务成功率。
视频理解LVBench：Gemini用 1FPS，Astra 800 帧、Fable 5.1 为 300 帧、Opus 5.5 为 600 帧，受到API限制。Terminal-Bench Science还有 6 倍验证器超时安排。

items.title: Gemini 4 Argon：长任务成绩领先在哪，哪些比较并不等价？

fields.1M窗口是容量，长任务仍需检验是否完整交付: A 1M window is capacity; long tasks still need completion checks
fields.Argon的知识工作与长上下文成绩值得关注，但选型仍须逐任务、逐配置理解；安全收: Argon’s knowledge-work and long-context results merit attention, but selection requires task- and setting-specific interpretation, with safety gains separate from residual risk.
fields.FieldToFit分析：最有用的读法，是先确定任务，再检查成绩的样本、工具与预: FieldToFit assessment: begin with the task, inspect samples, tools and budgets, then set permissions and human approval for irreversible actions. A mainstream brand or high score cannot replace validation on the actual workflow.
fields.FieldToFit本站重绘；公开数据来自Google DeepMind的 20: FieldToFit redraw using public data from Google DeepMind’s 2026-10 model card.
fields.FrontierSWE v2：Argon 55.0%，Astra 65.5%；T: FrontierSWE v2: Argon 55.0%, Astra 65.5%. Terminal-Bench 4.0: Argon 57.4%, Opus 5.5 66.4%; these rows do not show universal Argon leadership.
fields.Gemini 3.1 Pro是本表安全差值基线: Gemini 3.1 Pro is the baseline for the safety deltas
fields.Gemini 4 Argon：长任务成绩领先在哪，哪些比较并不等价？: Gemini 4 Argon: where it leads on long tasks, and which comparisons are not equivalent
fields.Google说明评测与查询集已改进，旧模型卡数字不能直接拼接比较；人工复核发现的: Google says evaluations and query sets were updated, limiting direct comparison with older cards. Its manual review describes most losses as false positives or non-egregious; that is the author’s explanation, not FieldToFit verification.
fields.GraphWalks BFS F1：短组 99.7%，长组 84.2%。: GraphWalks BFS F1: 99.7% on the shorter subset and 84.2% on the longer subset.
fields.GraphWalks长组 84.2%与短组 99.7%来自不同样本，不是无限记忆: GraphWalks 84.2% on the longer subset and 99.7% on the shorter subset use different samples, not a universal probability of memory or length degradation.
fields.OSWorld 2.0：离线子集部分分，3 次运行取最大，每次单次尝试；默认 1: OSWorld 2.0: offline-subset partial score, maximum over 3 runs with one attempt per run; default 1080p, up to 500 steps, Gemini CUA harness and parallel batched tool calls. Its 69.2% is not a complete-task success rate.
fields.PostTrainBench v1.1：全部模型由Google复测，OpenCo: PostTrainBench v1.1: Google retests all models using OpenCode, one NVIDIA H100 and a 10-hour budget; the data and weighting scope must accompany the score.
fields.PostTrainBench同一OpenCode、单H100、10 小时；OSW: PostTrainBench uses shared OpenCode, one H100 and 10 hours. OSWorld reports partial score on the offline subset, maximized over 3 runs.
fields.PostTrainBench：Argon 45.3%，Opus 5.5 为 49: PostTrainBench: Argon 45.3%, Opus 5.5 49.3%. Shared hardware and harness improve comparability, but the result remains a weighted aggregate over four base models and seven benchmarks.
fields.Vals Index：Argon 68.9%，GPT-6 Astra 63.1%: Vals Index: Argon 68.9%, GPT-6 Astra 63.1%, Fable 5.1 65.8%, Opus 5.5 67.0%; Argon leads within this row.
fields.Vals领先，但FrontierSWE、Terminal-Bench和PostT: Vals leads, while comparator models score higher on FrontierSWE, Terminal-Bench and PostTrainBench; avoid a false unified ranking.
fields.不平均不同基准，不从一行领先推出全任务领先。: Do not average distinct benchmarks or infer universal leadership from one row.
fields.不是所有模型、所有行均由Google同条件重测；视觉帧数也不同。: Google did not retest every model on every row under identical conditions; visual frame counts also differ.
fields.两个GraphWalks子集的BFS F1 为 99.7%和 84.2%，样本分: BFS F1 of 99.7% and 84.2% on two GraphWalks subsets, with 650 and 200 items.
fields.主流模型的能力证据与评测可比性: Evidence and comparability for a mainstream model
fields.产品：模型卡仍列幻觉、延迟／超时与 2026 年 3 月知识截止。检索、引用核对: Product use: the card retains hallucinations, latency/timeouts and a 2026-3 knowledge cutoff. Retrieval, citation checks and final-state verification remain useful.
fields.作者与外部榜单数据混合；本站未复现实验，未完成 217 页安全报告深读。: Mixes author and external-leaderboard results; FieldToFit has not reproduced experiments or fully read the 217-page safety report.
fields.作者称文本安全在置信区间内相近；生物／网络CCL及隐蔽／情境意识TCL不能排除，: The author describes text safety as similar within confidence intervals. Biological/cyber CCL and stealth/situational-awareness TCL cannot be ruled out; this does not establish zero risk.
fields.作者评测及缓解声明不等于独立安全认证，更不能把测试阈值转换为生产事故概率。: Author evaluations and mitigation claims are not independent safety certification, and test thresholds do not translate into production incident probabilities.
fields.内容安全、拒绝行为和前沿能力风险采用不同评估。: Content safety, refusals and frontier-capability risks use different assessments.
fields.分任务强项与落后项并存: Task strengths coexist with weaker rows
fields.前沿风险：生物与网络CCL不能排除；隐蔽／情境意识TCL不能排除。Google据: Frontier risk: biological/cyber CCL and stealth/situational-awareness TCL cannot be ruled out. Google responds with mitigations and residual-risk assessments rather than a zero-risk declaration.
fields.原卡只标 2026 年 10 月；首发日和独立修订号未核实。开放公告 10 月: The card gives only 2026-10; its first day and independent revision identifier are unverified. The 10/13 access announcement is not substituted for the card’s first publication day.
fields.原文仅链接；本站图形基于公开事实重新设计: Link upstream text only; redesign graphics from public factual data
fields.可以为自己的工作流建立小测试：长资料的引用定位、代码修改后的完整测试、超时后的接: Create a small workflow test covering citations in long documents, complete tests after code edits, recovery after timeouts and uncertainty disclosure. Record successes, failures, elapsed time and token costs rather than selecting only the best attempt.
fields.同一模型的上下文与分任务证据并列，非因果证明: Context and task evidence for the same model; not a causal claim
fields.同一组内部自动安全评测中的比较基线。: Comparison baseline in the same internal automated safety evaluations.
fields.四个基准分别展示四个模型分数，Argon并非每行最高。: Four separate benchmark rows for four models; Argon is not highest on every row.
fields.多数pass@1 且最高thinking；小集多次试验均值，具体例外另列。: Mostly pass@1 at highest thinking, with multiple-trial averaging for small sets and explicit exceptions.
fields.多数pass@1 并不覆盖所有行；OSWorld的部分分与 3 次最大值、不同视: Mostly pass@1 does not describe every row; OSWorld partial score/maximum over 3 and different visual frame counts need explicit disclosure.
fields.安全差值对照Gemini 3.1 Pro。多语、图像到文本、拒绝语气与过度拒绝总: Safety deltas compare with Gemini 3.1 Pro. Multilingual, image-to-text, refusal tone and over-refusal improve overall. Text safety has a raw +1.57pp change on a lower-is-better metric, while the author describes it as similar within confidence intervals. Keep the exception alongside the improvements.
fields.安全差值：+1.57、-3.16、-9.29、+5.50、-9.60 个百分点，: Safety deltas: +1.57, -3.16, -9.29, +5.50 and -9.60 percentage points, with metric-specific directions.
fields.安全收益与残余风险分别读: Read safety gains separately from residual risk
fields.安全表有改善也有例外，残余风险需另读: Safety tables show improvements and exceptions; residual risk is separate
fields.容量不是无限记忆；两组样本不同，不能把差值当同一任务随长度下降的因果。: Capacity is not unlimited memory. The subsets differ; their gap is not a causal estimate of degradation with length.
fields.容量：输入与输出合计最多 1M token；不是输入 1M再额外输出 1M。: Capacity: up to 1M tokens for input and output combined, not 1M input plus another 1M output.
fields.对照Gemini 3.1 Pro；内部自动评测及FSF阈值判断。: Relative to Gemini 3.1 Pro; internal automated tests and FSF threshold assessments.
fields.已读全文与关键图表；原文再分发许可未确认，只公开原创分析、来源链接和重绘统计。: The full text and key tables were read. Redistribution rights are unverified; publish original analysis, source links and redrawn statistics only.
fields.把运行框架与预算读进成绩: Read harness and budget with the score
fields.改进过的评测不与旧模型卡直接拼表。: Updated evaluations should not be directly combined with older model cards.
fields.文本、图像、音频、视频输入；文本输出；输入输出合计最多 1M token。: Text, image, audio and video input; text output; up to 1M combined input/output tokens.
fields.文本安全+1.57pp，多语-3.16pp，图像到文本-9.29pp；拒绝语气+: Text safety +1.57pp, multilingual -3.16pp, image-to-text -9.29pp; refusal tone +5.50pp, over-refusal -9.60pp.
fields.方法文档默认最高thinking、单次尝试，且小基准平均多次试验以降低波动。其他: The methods default to highest thinking and single attempts, averaging multiple trials for smaller benchmarks. Other providers generally contribute self-reported results at maximum reasoning when available, otherwise the best available result; this is not one uniform experiment.
fields.日期分开维护：模型 9 月 30 日发布、10 月 13 日扩大开放；本模型卡只: Maintain dates separately: model launch 9/30, broader access 10/13, card known only as 2026-10, and FieldToFit checking/publication on 10/14. Update for real new evidence or substantive revisions, without refreshing public dates for unchanged checks.
fields.本站重绘：不同子集使用同一指标，但不是同题重复实验，也不是记忆成功概率。: FieldToFit redraw: the subsets share a metric but are not repeated identical tasks or memory-success probabilities.
fields.本站重绘：保留原始符号和指标方向。未给绝对基线，不能换算事故率或相对降幅。: FieldToFit redraw: retain raw signs and metric directions. Without absolute baselines, do not derive incident rates or relative reductions.
fields.本站重绘：每行独立比较，横轴 0–100%。不跨行相加；对照数据来源和运行设置见: FieldToFit redraw: compare each row separately on a 0–100% axis. Do not sum across rows; sources and settings are explained in the text.
fields.本篇读完 14 页模型卡，不等于已完成 217 页安全报告和安全案例论证。模型、: Reading the 14-page card is not completion of the 217-page safety report or its safety cases. Consider the model together with tool permissions, monitoring and human approval.
fields.框架、预算和取分方式会改变“更强”的含义: Harness, budget and aggregation change what “better” means
fields.框架和样本不同不让结果失去价值，但限制了它能回答的问题；不能由分数反推真实用户的: Different harnesses and samples do not make results useless, but bound what they answer; scores do not determine real-user time, cost or incident rates.
fields.模型卡 2026 年 10 月矩阵；按行保留外部榜单与内部复测口径。: 2026-10 matrix, retaining external-leaderboard and internal-retest definitions by row.
fields.模型卡明确Argon不是旧模型的微调版本，而是新的稀疏MoE模型。多模态输入和多: The card says Argon is a new sparse-MoE model rather than a fine-tune of a prior model. Multimodal input and multi-step reasoning training support complex workflows, but it does not disclose total parameter count, modality shares or a complete training budget.
fields.模型卡：2026 年 10 月，日级首发与独立修订号未核实。10 月 13 日为: Model card: 2026-10; the exact first publication day and separate revision identifier are unverified. 10/13 is the access announcement; 10/14 is FieldToFit’s check and editorial event. Citations use physical PDF pages including the cover. Upstream text and figures are linked only; the charts are original redraws. The 217-page safety report has not been fully read and its safety argument is not established by this article.
fields.测试：最多 128K组 650 题；256K至 1M组 200 题，BFS F1: Testing: 650 items up to 128K and 200 problems from 256K to 1M, with BFS F1 of 99.7%/84.2%. The tasks differ; the 15.5-percentage-point gap does not estimate increased failure on the same task.
fields.深读 14 页模型卡与 5 页评测方法，用四条结论区分上下文容量、分任务成绩、运: Read the 14-page model card and 5-page evaluation methods through four findings separating context capacity, task scores, execution settings and safety assessment. Three original redraws retain units and comparisons. The card gives only 2026-10, without a verified first publication day; FieldToFit has not reproduced the experiments.
fields.百分点差值不是事故概率；内容安全评测与前沿风险阈值不是同一套分数。: Percentage-point deltas are not incident probabilities; content-safety tests and frontier-risk thresholds are separate assessments.
fields.知识工作、代码、终端与机器学习工程分别计分。: Knowledge work, coding, terminal tasks and ML engineering are scored separately.
fields.知识工作强项不能替代每项任务的独立比较: Strength in knowledge work does not replace task-by-task comparison
fields.稀疏MoE，原生多模态输入；RL包含多步推理与问题求解数据。: Sparse MoE with native multimodal input; RL includes multi-step reasoning and problem-solving data.
fields.第 6 页矩阵的价值是把不同工作类型展开。知识工作和工程任务没有同一个分母；即便: The physical page 6 matrix separates work types. Knowledge and engineering tasks do not share a denominator; percentage units alone do not justify averaging them into a general agent success rate.
fields.绝对百分点变化；每项更好方向分别定义。: Absolute percentage-point changes, with metric-specific improvement directions.
fields.能力、条件与风险分开判断: Assess capability, conditions and risk separately
fields.能力成绩与安全判断分别评估: Capability scores and safety assessments are distinct
fields.表内只报告差值，并未给所有绝对发生率。: The table gives deltas rather than every absolute occurrence rate.
fields.视频理解LVBench：Gemini用 1FPS，Astra 800 帧、Fab: Video understanding on LVBench: Gemini uses 1FPS, Astra 800 frames, Fable 5.1 300 and Opus 5.5 600, constrained by APIs. Terminal-Bench Science also uses a 6× verifier timeout.
fields.选型应从自己的任务类型出发，先判断结果对应的工作流与评分是否接近实际业务。: Selection should begin with the actual task, checking whether the workflow and grading resemble the intended business use.
fields.配置、子集、取样与供应商自报共同限定比较。: Settings, subsets, sampling and provider-reported results bound the comparisons.
fields.配置说明与结果对应阅读，不把框架当模型继承: Read settings with results; harnesses are not model inheritance
fields.长上下文提高可放入的信息量，不自动证明模型能正确使用每条信息或交付无人监督任务。: A longer context increases information capacity; it does not establish correct use of every detail or unsupervised task completion.
fields.首次整理所选模型卡：四条结论、同号论述、三张本站重绘，保留月份日期与指标条件。: First analysis of the selected card: four findings, matching arguments and three original redraws, retaining month precision and metric conditions.

items.title: nanoMuse 1.0.4：加强跨设备审批与凭据存储，iOS通道需分开看

fields.MCP敏感环境配置转入加密凭据存储；拒绝含密码的URL，避免向未知重定向主机转发: Sensitive MCP environment configuration moves to an encrypted credential store; password-bearing URLs are rejected and keys are not forwarded to unknown redirect hosts. These are specific safeguards, not a verified independent security audit of the whole system.
fields.nanoMuse 1.0.4：加强跨设备审批与凭据存储，iOS通道需分开看: nanoMuse 1.0.4: stronger cross-device approvals and credential storage, with separate iOS rollout
fields.nanoMuse是社区个人Agent，并非Meta官方Muse。1.0.4 于北: nanoMuse is a community personal agent, not Meta’s official Muse. Version 1.0.4 was released at 01:30 Beijing time on 2026-10-13, adding encrypted credentials, cross-device action approvals and desktop DeepSeek Harness integration.

fields.原始时间：2026-10-12T17:30:52Z；事件日期（北京时间或发布者日: Upstream time: 2026-10-12T17:30:52Z; event date (Beijing or publisher calendar date): 2026-10-13; checked:2026-10-13; version: v1.0.4; FieldToFit has not installed, run or reproduced performance.

TestFlight submission, review and the version available to iOS users are separate; desktop 1.0.4 is not assumed to be available to all iOS users. GPL-3.0-or-later; external model services, cross-device synchronization and iOS’s inability to control other applications remain relevant.
fields.跨设备操作可在发起任务的手机上审批；支付只允许单次批准或拒绝，审批超时按拒绝处理: Cross-device actions can be approved on the phone that initiated the task. Payments allow one-time approval or denial, and approval timeouts are treated as denial. FieldToFit has not tested actual device permissions or timeout behavior.

technical_map.question: Muse Wonder：持续记忆与长任务，怎样读懂能力和安全评测？

editorial: FieldToFit判断：本次最值得跟进的是有长期状态的Agent是否能完整交付，而非把单一记忆分数当作产品成熟度。实际选型可先建立含更新、冲突、重启和最终状态验证的小型业务测试。
模型、运行框架与应用配置共同影响结果。网站的模型动态负责说明发布与入口，本篇专题负责解释原始证据和边界；社区nanoMuse另有作者和版本，不作为Meta官方模型的别名。
后续只在新的正式模型卡、真实评测修订或明确入口变化出现时更新本篇；原始发布日期、报告修订、本站核对与文章修订分别记载。本站未安装、运行或复现模型评测。

blocks.text: 官方发布把Active Memory描述为可利用既有对话资料的能力，并以Active Focus强调持续推进目标与处理阻塞。模型卡给出的可核证据则更具体：输入上下文为 1M token；MemoryBench测试长多轮对话中的关键事实，其中同时有干扰对话、互相冲突的细节和之后更新的信息。这里的产品功能、输入容量和测试任务需要分别理解。

items: MemoryBench对话长度为 64K–100K token，由LLM评判器按问题特定的加权标准计分；它不是在 1M token全长上测出同样的回忆可靠性。
模型卡表中Full为 85.5、Wonder为 85.6；这些是该项测试的报告分数，不能解释为任意个人资料被正确记住的概率。
本文未验证不同用户的隔离、删除语义、跨端同步或记忆保留期限；模型卡也未提供这些行为的完整产品测试。

blocks.alt: 输入容量 1M token与MemoryBench的 64K–100K token范围分别展示；Full分数 85.5、Wonder 85.6。
blocks.attribution: FieldToFit 本站重绘；数据与测试说明来自 Meta 2026-10-12 模型卡。
blocks.caption: 图 1｜本站阅读示意：框的面积不代表token数量；输入容量与记忆测试口径分开。

blocks.label: limit
blocks.text: 从测试中的回忆能力到可长期信任的个人Agent，还需要应用层的记忆更新、冲突处理、数据隔离与删除验证。

findings.summary: 1M token输入容量、64K–100K token记忆测试与实际跨会话产品是三个不同层面。记住测试里的关键事实，不能自动推出所有长期任务都可靠。
findings.title: 持续记忆值得看，但证据仍来自有界测试

blocks.text: OSWorld V2.1 使用完整Ubuntu桌面上的 108 个真实工作流。Agent通过截图、点击、输入、滚动等动作操作环境，程序化评分器核对任务结果。模型卡将平均每任务部分奖励作为主要指标，并另列严格二元完成率。分步完成一些要求也能获得部分分数；是否全部完成则要另看严格指标。

items: Wonder Full（max）：部分得分 78.4，严格完成 39.4%；Wonder（max）：72.6 与 34.3%。两项保留各自名称，不把 78.4 写成完整成功率。
内部控制的代码对照尽量采用同一评测运行框架；外部代码结果保留发布方或模型供应方采用的Agent产品。SWE-Marathon明确不是同一运行框架的受控比较。
部分比较结果来自第三方，部分来自供应方或内部验证；竞争模型的提示、工具和运行配置采用尽力匹配。每一行都需保留来源与条件，不能据整张表推出统一的全场景排名。

blocks.alt: OSWorld V2.1 两种计分：Full为 78.4 部分得分与 39.4%严格完成；Wonder为 72.6 与 34.3%。
blocks.attribution: FieldToFit 本站重绘；数据与测试说明来自 Meta 2026-10-12 模型卡。
blocks.caption: 图 2｜本站重绘，纵轴从 0 到 100；平均部分奖励乘 100 与严格完成百分比分别标记，不由差值推算失败概率。
blocks.license: Graphics © FieldToFit; original data: Meta model card.

blocks.label: evidence
blocks.text: 对实际自动化，更关键的问题是最终状态是否满足全部要求，而不只是执行轨迹看起来推进了多少。

findings.summary: OSWorld V2.1 为 108 个工作流同时给出部分奖励与严格完成。Wonder Full的 78.4 与 39.4%并非两种模型强弱排名，而是同一任务集合的两种计分。
findings.title: 长任务取得部分进展，仍可能没有完整交付

blocks.text: Muse Wonder Full在ExploitGym取得 92 个标记。模型卡并未把这个总数直接当作排名成绩：GPT-cyber验证器检查了利用路径，随后由Gemini 3.1 Pro独立确认，其中 21 个经预期漏洞取得，71 个经非预期漏洞取得。公开排名仅计预期漏洞利用，所以可与公开排名比较的是 21。

items: 92、21、71 的单位均为取得的标记，不是独立漏洞数；模型卡此处没有给出用于计算整体任务成功率的完整尝试分母。
非预期路径不能直接加入受限定规则的排名，但也不能简单说成没有攻击意义。评价真实系统风险时，超出预定测试路径的行为仍值得调查。
能力测试与防越狱测试属于不同问题。CyberBench、PolyGuard等攻击成功率有各自提示与单轮／多轮条件，不能用标记数或某个低攻击成功率代替完整安全结论。

blocks.alt: 共取得 92 个标记，其中 21 个对应预期漏洞、71 个对应非预期漏洞；只有 21 用于与公开排名比较。
blocks.attribution: FieldToFit 本站重绘；数据与测试说明来自 Meta 2026-10-12 模型卡。
blocks.caption: 图 3｜本站重绘，横轴为标记数量；21＋71＝92。没有绘制整体任务成功率，也不把标记数量当独立漏洞数。
blocks.license: Graphics © FieldToFit; original data: Meta model card.

blocks.label: limit
blocks.text: 先读什么被计入分数，再谈能力提升；越过预设路径的结果需要同时接受基准规则与现实风险的两种检查。

findings.summary: 验证后只有 21 个标记通过预期漏洞取得，其余 71 个通过非预期漏洞取得。这个差别同时影响基准可比性和对真实攻击能力的理解。
findings.title: 攻击测试取得 92 个标记，不等于 92 个可比排名成绩

blocks.text: 模型卡用Wonder Full作为家族中最强变体进行风险评估。在Meta自己的风险框架中，未缓解模型在网络安全和失去控制领域被评为moderate or lower，但生化领域的高风险阈值不能排除。针对这个领域加入安全后训练、系统级分类器等措施后，作者才将所有领域评为moderate or lower，并据此支持部署决定。

items: 一般能力评测方法说明拒答计零分并留在分母；生化代理评测表的特定脚注则注明先剔除拒答。阅读时按表保留这一区别，不把两种分母规则合并。
Agentic Misalignment在所测场景报告 0%有害行为，MASK为 87.3%；样本和场景边界仍适用，不能把某次零事件观察转换成所有部署的零风险。
模型卡仍列出事实错误、多步推理、空间／3D任务、未充分评估的语言，以及量化、服务配置、提示、工具和运行框架带来的变化。真实不可逆动作也需额外的人类确认等防护。

blocks.label: limit
blocks.text: 作者的残余风险判断必须连同缓解措施与框架定义一起读；它没有替应用开发者完成具体业务、语言与操作权限的验证。
获取方式也属于部署条件：Wonder提供API与Muse Code入口，Full在Muse Code订阅入口提供，消费者产品更新分阶段推出。本篇没有核实各地区、额度、价格或权重开放条件，因此保留官方入口，不扩写成人人可用或开放权重的发布。

findings.summary: 作者未排除未缓解模型在生化领域达到高风险阈值，加入防护后才形成各领域moderate or lower的部署判断。它不是所有环境的安全保证。
findings.title: 安全缓解后的风险判断，保留框架和部署条件

reading.title: 这份模型卡的四条核心结论
