technical_map.takeaway: 持续记忆与长任务能力要连同评测范围、完整完成率、利用路径和部署防护一起判断；模型卡提供可审证据，但仍有应用场景验证缺口。

items.title: Muse Wonder：持续记忆与长任务，怎样读懂能力和安全评测？

fields.1M token输入容量、64K–100K token记忆测试与实际跨会话产品是: A 1M-token input capacity, a 64K–100K-token memory benchmark and the cross-session product are three different layers. Remembering key test facts does not establish reliability for every long-running task.
fields.1M推理上下文不是这个测试的长度；没有无限会话、所有语言或隐私行为的验证。: The 1M inference context is not this test’s length; unlimited conversations, every-language performance and privacy behavior are not established.
fields.92 个标记：21 个经预期漏洞取得、71 个经非预期漏洞取得；可比排名用 21: 92 captured flags: 21 via intended vulnerabilities and 71 via unintended vulnerabilities; 21 is comparable with the published ranking.
fields.92、21、71 的单位均为取得的标记，不是独立漏洞数；模型卡此处没有给出用于计: The units for 92, 21 and 71 are captured flags, not distinct vulnerabilities; this passage does not provide the complete attempt denominator for an overall task-success rate.
fields.Agentic Misalignment在所测场景报告 0%有害行为，MASK为: Agentic Misalignment reports 0% harmful action in the tested scenarios and MASK scores 87.3%; sample and scenario limits still apply, and zero observed events do not establish zero risk in every deployment.
fields.FieldToFit 本站重绘；数据与测试说明来自 Meta 2026-10-1: FieldToFit redraw; data and evaluation descriptions from Meta’s 2026-10-12 model card.
fields.FieldToFit判断：本次最值得跟进的是有长期状态的Agent是否能完整交付: FieldToFit assessment: the most useful follow-up is whether a stateful long-running agent completes delivery, alongside its recall score. Practical selection can begin with a small workflow test covering updates, conflicts, restarts and final-state verification.
fields.Full 85.5，Wonder 85.6，为模型卡报告分数。: Full 85.5 and Wonder 85.6 are the scores reported in the model card.
fields.MemoryBench对话长度为 64K–100K token，由LLM评判器按: MemoryBench conversations contain 64K–100K tokens and are scored by an LLM judge using weighted question-specific rubrics. The result does not establish identical recall reliability across the full 1M-token context.
fields.MemoryBench；64K–100K token；LLM评判与加权问题标准。: MemoryBench; 64K–100K tokens; LLM judging and weighted question-specific rubrics.
fields.Meta Superintelligence Scaling Framework: Meta Superintelligence Scaling Framework; Wonder Full is used for the family’s risk assessment.
fields.Muse Wonder Full在ExploitGym取得 92 个标记。模型卡: Muse Wonder Full captured 92 flags in ExploitGym. The model card does not treat that total as a ranking score: a GPT-cyber verifier checked the exploitation paths, independently confirmed by Gemini 3.1 Pro;21 used intended vulnerabilities and 71 used unintended vulnerabilities. The published ranking counts intended-vulnerability exploitations only, so 21 is the comparable figure.
fields.Muse Wonder Full；ExploitGym；GPT-cyber验证并: Muse Wonder Full; ExploitGym; GPT-cyber verification with independent confirmation by Gemini 3.1 Pro.
fields.Muse Wonder 官方发布与产品入口: Muse Wonder official launch and product access
fields.Muse Wonder 模型卡 · 官方全文入口: Muse Wonder model card · official full-text entry
fields.Muse Wonder：持续记忆与长任务，怎样读懂能力和安全评测？: Muse Wonder: reading the evidence for persistent memory, long tasks and safety
fields.OSWorld V2.1 两种计分：Full为 78.4 部分得分与 39.4%: Two OSWorld V2.1 metrics: Full has partial score 78.4 and strict completion 39.4%; Wonder has 72.6 and 34.3%.
fields.OSWorld V2.1 为 108 个工作流同时给出部分奖励与严格完成。Won: OSWorld V2.1 reports partial reward and strict completion for 108 workflows. Wonder Full’s 78.4 and 39.4% are two grading rules on the same task set, rather than two rankings of model strength.
fields.OSWorld V2.1 使用完整Ubuntu桌面上的 108 个真实工作流。A: OSWorld V2.1 uses 108 real workflows on a full Ubuntu desktop. The agent acts through screenshots, clicks, typing and scrolling, and programmatic graders check results. The model card uses mean per-task partial reward as the primary metric and separately reports strict binary completion. Completing some requirements can earn partial credit; full completion requires the strict metric.
fields.OSWorld V2.1；108 个Ubuntu桌面工作流；内部共同框架；max: OSWorld V2.1; 108 Ubuntu desktop workflows; a common internal framework; max reasoning configuration.
fields.Wonder Full（max）：部分得分 78.4，严格完成 39.4%；Wo: Wonder Full (max): partial score 78.4 and strict completion 39.4%; Wonder (max): 72.6 and 34.3%. Keep the metric names and do not label 78.4 as a complete-success rate.
fields.Wonder Full：78.4 部分得分／39.4%严格成功；Wonder：7: Wonder Full: 78.4 partial score / 39.4% strict success; Wonder: 72.6 / 34.3%.
fields.一般能力评测方法说明拒答计零分并留在分母；生化代理评测表的特定脚注则注明先剔除拒: The general capability methodology gives refusals zero credit and retains them in the denominator; a specific footnote in the chemical and biological proxy table says refusals are dropped before scoring. Retain that distinction rather than combine the two denominator rules.
fields.从测试中的回忆能力到可长期信任的个人Agent，还需要应用层的记忆更新、冲突处理: Moving from benchmark recall to a trustworthy long-running personal agent still requires application-level checks of memory updates, conflict handling, data isolation and deletion.
fields.从记忆测试的上下文范围，到桌面工作流的两种计分，再到攻击能力与安全缓解，逐层阅读: Read the Muse Wonder model card through memory-test scope, two desktop-workflow scoring rules, cyber capability and safety mitigations. Four core findings, matching arguments and three FieldToFit redraws keep model capabilities, system conditions and the author’s risk assessment separate.
fields.作者在加入缓解措施后，将各风险领域评为moderate or lower。: After mitigations, the author assesses each risk domain as moderate or lower.
fields.作者实验未复现；不同运行框架与评分分母分别保留。仅链接原文，图表为本站重绘；不由: The author’s experiments have not been reproduced. Harnesses and scoring denominators remain separate. Upstream material is linked and figures are FieldToFit redraws; the card does not establish unverified prices, weight access or universal safety.
fields.作者未排除未缓解模型在生化领域达到高风险阈值，加入防护后才形成各领域modera: The author does not rule out the unmitigated model reaching the high-risk threshold in the chemical and biological domain. The moderate or lower deployment assessment follows mitigations; it is not a safety guarantee for every environment.
fields.作者的残余风险判断必须连同缓解措施与框架定义一起读；它没有替应用开发者完成具体业: Read the author’s residual-risk assessment together with its mitigations and framework definitions; it does not complete the application developer’s validation of specific workflows, languages and action permissions.
fields.先读什么被计入分数，再谈能力提升；越过预设路径的结果需要同时接受基准规则与现实风: Read what is counted before discussing capability gains; results beyond the intended path require both a benchmark-rule check and a real-risk assessment.
fields.共取得 92 个标记，其中 21 个对应预期漏洞、71 个对应非预期漏洞；只有: 92 flags captured:21 via intended vulnerabilities and 71 via unintended vulnerabilities; only 21 is comparable with the published ranking.
fields.内部控制的代码对照尽量采用同一评测运行框架；外部代码结果保留发布方或模型供应方采: Controlled internal coding comparisons use a common benchmark-specific harness where practical; external coding results retain the reporting vendor’s or model provider’s agent product. SWE-Marathon is explicitly not a controlled common-harness comparison.
fields.原文仅链接；公开统计事实用于本站重新设计的图表: Upstream text is linked only; public statistical facts are used in newly designed FieldToFit figures
fields.同一模型同一任务的部分得分 78.4；计分定义不同，不计算因果差值: Partial score 78.4 for the same model and tasks; the grading definitions differ, so no causal difference is calculated
fields.后续只在新的正式模型卡、真实评测修订或明确入口变化出现时更新本篇；原始发布日期、: Update this article when a new official model card, substantive evaluation revision or verified access change appears. Original release, report revision, FieldToFit check and article revision are recorded separately. FieldToFit has not installed, run or reproduced the model evaluations.
fields.四个并行核对面：记忆测试范围、工作流完整交付、攻击计分与系统缓解。沿线阅读报告位: Four parallel checks: memory-test scope, complete workflow delivery, cyber scoring and system mitigations. Follow the report locations while preserving each metric’s definition.
fields.图 1｜本站阅读示意：框的面积不代表token数量；输入容量与记忆测试口径分开。: Figure 1 | FieldToFit reading diagram: box area does not represent token count; input capacity and memory-test scope are separate.
fields.图 2｜本站重绘，纵轴从 0 到 100；平均部分奖励乘 100 与严格完成百分: Figure 2 | FieldToFit redraw with a 0 to 100 axis; mean partial reward multiplied by 100 and strict completion percentage are labeled separately, without inferring failure probability from their difference.
fields.图 3｜本站重绘，横轴为标记数量；21＋71＝92。没有绘制整体任务成功率，也不: Figure 3 | FieldToFit redraw; the axis counts flags, with 21＋71＝92. No overall task-success rate is plotted, and flag count is not treated as a count of distinct vulnerabilities.
fields.安全缓解后的风险判断，保留框架和部署条件: Retain the framework and deployment conditions of mitigated-risk judgments
fields.官方发布把Active Memory描述为可利用既有对话资料的能力，并以Acti: The launch describes Active Memory as drawing on prior conversations and Active Focus as maintaining goals and working through blockers. The model card gives narrower verifiable evidence: a 1M-token input context and MemoryBench tests of key facts in long multi-turn conversations, with distractors, conflicting details and later updates. Product features, input capacity and benchmark tasks should be interpreted separately.
fields.对实际自动化，更关键的问题是最终状态是否满足全部要求，而不只是执行轨迹看起来推进: For practical automation, the more consequential question is whether the final state meets every requirement, alongside how much progress the trajectory appears to make.
fields.对攻击能力测试取得的标记做验证，将预期漏洞与非预期漏洞路径区分。: Verify captured flags in cyber-capability testing and distinguish intended from unintended vulnerability paths.
fields.已读完整模型卡并核对图表页面；原文再分发许可未确认，公开仅保留出处及本站原创分析: The complete model card and table pages were read. Upstream redistribution rights are unverified; the public article contains source links and original FieldToFit analysis only.
fields.并列核对记忆与端到端任务: Review memory and end-to-end tasks in parallel
fields.持续记忆与长任务能力要连同评测范围、完整完成率、利用路径和部署防护一起判断；模型: Judge persistent memory and long-task capability together with test scope, complete-success metrics, exploitation paths and deployment safeguards. The card provides reviewable evidence while leaving application-specific validation gaps.
fields.持续记忆值得看，但证据仍来自有界测试: Persistent memory matters, while the evidence remains bounded
fields.攻击测试取得 92 个标记，不等于 92 个可比排名成绩: Capturing 92 flags does not produce 92 ranking-comparable results
fields.攻击能力与部署缓解属于同一风险框架的不同核对面: Cyber capability and deployment mitigations are separate checks within the risk framework
fields.未缓解的生化领域高风险不能排除；特定测试 0%有害行为不代表所有场景零风险。: High risk in the unmitigated chemical and biological domain is not ruled out; 0% harmful action in a specific test does not establish zero risk in every scenario.
fields.本文未验证不同用户的隔离、删除语义、跨端同步或记忆保留期限；模型卡也未提供这些行: This article has not verified isolation between users, deletion semantics, cross-device synchronization or memory-retention periods; the model card does not provide comprehensive product tests of these behaviors.
fields.本文深读官方模型卡的能力、风险评估与局限章节，并核对发布入口。它是本站专题首次整: This article reads the model card’s capabilities, risk assessment and limitations and checks the launch entry. It is FieldToFit’s first treatment of this topic: the model was released on 2026-10-12 and checked here on 2026-10-13. The experiments have not been reproduced.
fields.本次读取发布日公开模型卡；未标独立修订号，未核到后续实质修订。: Read the model card available on its release date; no separate revision identifier or later substantive revision was verified.
fields.标记数不是不同漏洞数量，也不是以全部任务为分母的成功率。: Flag count is neither a count of distinct vulnerabilities nor a success rate over all attempted tasks.
fields.桌面工作流由真实任务环境和程序化评分器评价，部分奖励与严格完成是两种指标。: Desktop workflows use real task environments and programmatic graders; partial reward and strict completion are separate metrics.
fields.模型、运行框架与应用配置共同影响结果。网站的模型动态负责说明发布与入口，本篇专题: Models, harnesses and application configuration jointly affect results. The model news item explains release and access, while this article examines primary evidence and its limits. Community nanoMuse has its own author and versions and is not an alias for Meta’s official model.
fields.模型卡仍列出事实错误、多步推理、空间／3D任务、未充分评估的语言，以及量化、服务: The card still lists factual errors, multi-step reasoning, spatial/3D tasks, insufficiently evaluated languages, and variation with quantization, serving configuration, prompts, tools and harnesses. Real irreversible actions require additional safeguards such as human confirmation.
fields.模型卡用Wonder Full作为家族中最强变体进行风险评估。在Meta自己的风: The model card uses Wonder Full, the family’s strongest variant, for risk assessment. Within Meta’s framework, the unmitigated model is assessed as moderate or lower for cybersecurity and loss of control, while the high-risk threshold in the chemical and biological domain cannot be ruled out. After safety post-training, system-level classifiers and other mitigations for that domain, the author assesses every domain as moderate or lower and uses that assessment to support deployment.
fields.模型卡表中Full为 85.5、Wonder为 85.6；这些是该项测试的报告分: The model card reports 85.5 for Full and 85.6 for Wonder. These are benchmark scores, not the probability that any arbitrary piece of personal information will be remembered correctly.
fields.用测试口径解释能力，保留真实产品边界: Explain capabilities through test definitions and retain product boundaries
fields.结合安全后训练、系统级分类器与应用场景防护进行风险评估。: Assess risk with safety post-training, system-level classifiers and application-specific safeguards.
fields.能力测试与防越狱测试属于不同问题。CyberBench、PolyGuard等攻击: Capability tests and jailbreak-resistance tests answer different questions. Attack-success rates from CyberBench and PolyGuard have their own prompts and single-turn or multi-turn conditions; neither flag count nor one low attack-success rate establishes comprehensive safety.
fields.能力结果与攻击能力分别评测: Assess task results and cyber capability separately
fields.获取方式也属于部署条件：Wonder提供API与Muse Code入口，Full: Access is also a deployment condition: Wonder has API and Muse Code access, Full is offered through Muse Code subscriptions, and consumer-product updates roll out in stages. This article has not verified regional access, quotas, prices or weight availability, so it links official entries without claiming universal access or open weights.
fields.跨轮次回忆关键事实，并处理干扰、冲突和后续更新。: Recall key facts across turns with distractors, conflicting turns and later updates.
fields.输入容量 1M token与MemoryBench的 64K–100K toke: Input capacity of 1M tokens and MemoryBench’s 64K–100K-token scope shown separately; Full scores 85.5 and Wonder 85.6.
fields.这份模型卡的四条核心结论: Four core findings from the model card
fields.部分完成与完整成功分开: Separate partial progress from complete success
fields.部分得分不等于任务成功率；不同评测行的运行框架与结果来源须分别读。: Partial score is not a task success rate; harnesses and result sources must be read separately for each benchmark row.
fields.部分比较结果来自第三方，部分来自供应方或内部验证；竞争模型的提示、工具和运行配置: Some comparison results come from third parties, others from providers or internal validation; competitor prompts, tools and runtime configurations are best-effort matches. Preserve the source and conditions of each row rather than derive a universal ranking from the whole table.
fields.采用 2026-10-12 公开模型卡，未标独立修订号，未核实后续实质修订。原文: Uses the publicly available 2026-10-12 model card, which has no separate revision identifier; no later substantive revision has been verified. Upstream date, FieldToFit check date and article publication remain separate. The author’s experiments have not been reproduced here. Upstream text and artwork are linked only; the three figures are original FieldToFit redraws or reading diagrams.
fields.长任务取得部分进展，仍可能没有完整交付: Partial progress on a long task can fall short of complete delivery
fields.非预期路径不能直接加入受限定规则的排名，但也不能简单说成没有攻击意义。评价真实系: Unintended paths cannot simply be added to a ranking with restricted rules, but that does not make them irrelevant to attack capability. Behavior beyond the intended test path still matters when assessing real-system risk.
fields.风险判断依赖缓解与场景: Risk assessment depends on mitigations and context
fields.首次整理Muse Wonder 2026-10-12 模型卡：四条结论与对应论述: First analysis of the Muse Wonder 2026-10-12 model card: four findings and matching arguments, three FieldToFit redraws, memory scope, two workflow metrics, flag classification and mitigation conditions.
fields.验证后只有 21 个标记通过预期漏洞取得，其余 71 个通过非预期漏洞取得。这个: Verification found 21 flags captured through intended vulnerabilities and 71 through unintended vulnerabilities. This distinction affects benchmark comparability and the interpretation of real attack capability.

interpretation.locator: 仓库 README：What is REA／MCP 与 skill；FAQ：分析范围与工作流
interpretation.text: REA（Reverse Engineer Anything）把反汇编、伪代码、引用关系和运行行为组织为本地 MCP 工具，再用匹配的调查技能指导编码 Agent。它可帮助阅读没有源码的软件、分析兼容性或重建已明确验收标准的功能；CLI 也能使用同一工作流。REA 提供工具与证据组织，不是一款新的基础模型。
interpretation.title: 它解决什么：让 Agent 沿证据调查软件行为

interpretation.text: 10月10日的重建经验文章强调让 Agent 保留工作记忆、使用参考行为校验，并披露一次字节比较漏查浮点常量、错误接受结果的经历。我们的判断是：REA 值得关注之处在于把分析、假设与复核接起来；采用时还应审查比较工具、增加负例，不能只看“通过”标记或展示案例。该文是实践经验，不提供通用成功率或速度基准。

fields.REA把逆向分析工具接给编码Agent，用可追溯证据调查软件行为。6.4.0新增: REA connects reverse-engineering tools to coding agents, using traceable evidence to investigate software behavior. Version 6.4.0 adds Android inspection and on-demand access to large evidence sets. The official game-reconstruction example shows verifiable progress and also warns that the verifier itself can be wrong.
fields.REA（Reverse Engineer Anything）把反汇编、伪代码、引: REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) organizes disassembly, pseudocode, references and runtime behavior into local MCP tools, then guides coding agents with matching investigation skills. It can help read software without source code, analyze compatibility or reconstruct functionality with explicit acceptance criteria. The CLI supports the same workflow. REA provides tools and evidence organization; it is not a new foundation model.

fields.北京时间10月11日11:58发布的6.4.0新增 ADB 设备检查、拆分 AP: Version 6.4.0, released at 11:58 Beijing time on 10/11, adds ADB device inspection, split-APK retrieval, logs and screenshots, plus application lifecycle operations that require explicit execution. Apktool reads manifests and localized strings; JEB connects to local projects. Large analyses can start with summaries and retrieve selected evidence. JavaScript analysis sets memory and timeout boundaries, preserving completed facts and unknowns when resources are exhausted.
fields.原文仅链接；发布本站原创整理、准确版本与案例边界。: Original text is link-only. Publish FieldToFit's original summary with accurate versions and example limitations.
fields.可接入 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI；: Supports Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Gemini CLI; 6.4.0 also adds Pi, Hermes and Qwen Code. Installing skill files alone is insufficient; MCP configuration is still required. Deep native-program analysis uses engines such as Ghidra, Hopper or IDA. Static JavaScript / .NET paths do not require a native engine. The project is MIT-licensed; external tools have their own installation and usage conditions.
fields.它解决什么：让 Agent 沿证据调查软件行为: What it solves: guiding agents through evidence about software behavior
fields.官方 DX-Ball 案例记录的是 REA 4.1.0，不是6.4.0的性能评测: The official DX-Ball example records REA 4.1.0, not a performance evaluation of 6.4.0. Its sound-panning function passed 3,205 behavioral comparisons on the original x86 platform and matched 63 bytes of compiled output under fixed compiler conditions. The 10/7 project checkpoint still lists a fully playable reconstruction as ongoing. Passing one function does not establish that arbitrary programs can be completely recovered. FieldToFit has not installed or independently reproduced it.
fields.怎么接入：本地工具、匹配技能与实际分析引擎: How to connect: local tools, matching skills and actual analysis engines
fields.本条记录6.4.0版本事件，不称项目于今日首发。GitHub固定标签与npm最新: This records the 6.4.0 version event, without claiming the project first launched today. The pinned GitHub tag and latest npm version were both checked as 6.4.0. The example uses 4.1.0; dates and versions remain separate. fields.目标分析在本地进行，但 Agent 获得的分析结果仍受所用模型服务的数据政策约束: Target analysis runs locally, but analysis results received by the agent remain subject to the chosen model service's data policies. This does not establish that the whole workflow is offline. Windows P0 in 6.4.0 remains read-only; some Windows NativeAOT workflows have not been verified on a real Windows host. Upgrading users should also check migration guidance for older evidence formats and update pinned MCP configuration.

technical_map.question: MiMo-V2.6：长任务 Agent 的提升，来自怎样的强化学习？

editorial: 本站判断：这份报告的价值是解释训练闭环怎样工作，而不是再排列一组最终模型分数。环境、评分器、harness、内存与调度都会进入“能力”的形成过程；采用者和研究者应分别核对模型能力、任务环境与实际执行配置。
读成绩时先辨认阶段与口径：混合 RL 训练曲线、特定配置消融、MOPD2 后的最终检查点、开源 9B 分领域实验分别回答不同问题。将它们合成一个“提升倍数”会抹掉关键条件；更稳妥的展示是保留原始指标、比较基线与报告位置。
对采用决策，本篇提供训练机制与可信度边界，不替代本地任务测试，也不承诺某个 API 已切换到相同检查点。能否减少你的工具循环、等待和失败，仍要在固定版本、权限、任务与预算下验证。

blocks.text: MiMo-V2.6 是一组多模态 MoE 模型。报告写 Pro 总参数 1.02T、激活 42B，Flash 总参数 310B、激活 15B；Flash 模型卡此前使用 309B，本篇保留报告口径，未推造两者差异的原因。模型先经历预训练与 agent-centric 中期训练，再进入混合任务 RL 和后续蒸馏。

items: 计算规模：训练每步使用 1,568 个 prompt × 16 条 rollout，约 25K 轨迹与 2.7–3.7B tokens，上下文最长 1M。异步 partial rollout 将未完成轨迹延续到后续训练阶段；这些是训练配置，不能直接当作每个 API 入口的上下文承诺。
环境扩展：任务涉及代码、通用工具工作流、视觉和网络安全；报告将训练任务与多个 harness 混合。held-out harness 检查提供跨框架泛化线索，但不能证明对任意真实业务都同样有效。
评分与工程：Pro 的报告 RL 计算费用中 rollout 占 43.8%、训练占 43.5%、grader 占 12.7%。评分本身需要工具环境与执行计算，harness pool、数据／控制平面分离及 Sample Mixer 也属于路线。

findings.summary: 更长、更大的训练批次只是其中一环。任务与 harness 多样性、验证质量、评分预算和异步调度共同决定模型能学到什么。
findings.title: 长任务能力的扩展，同时依赖算力、环境和反馈

blocks.text: 二值测试擅长判断任务是否通过，却可能把合理修复、过度改动与碰巧过关的实现赋予相同奖励。报告的重点是让评分器查看代码、运行证据与行为轨迹，再为组内的质量差异提供可训练信号。

items: GRS：先比较同一任务的多条离线轨迹，构造任务相关的实现标准与行为标准；后续每条轨迹单独评分。测试奖励乘以两个 rubric 分数，失败仍为零，通过者也能因质量不同得到不同奖励。
GAR：在线检查同组成功与失败轨迹，允许读取仓库和做针对性测试，再按解法适当性、实现精确性、最小改动、额外影响及代码质量排序。确认依赖外部泄漏答案的轨迹先被置零，余下通过者再分配正优势。
另有行为正则：组相对长度惩罚与片段级惩罚约束冗长、无效或重复动作。它们不等于 GRS／GAR 本身，也不意味着所有工具循环已被解决。

blocks.alt: GRS：离线轨迹比较 → 任务 rubric → 测试奖励与质量分数组合。GAR：组内在线检查 → 修正作弊奖励 → 通过解法排序 → 正优势重分配。两者用于不同任务子集，不表示性能倍数。
blocks.attribution: FieldToFit 本站重绘／示意；依据 Xiaomi LLM-Core，arXiv 2610.11959 v1
blocks.caption: 图 2 · GRS 与 GAR 怎样区分通过解法（本站方法示意；无数值尺度）
blocks.license: 图形 © FieldToFit；公开数据与方法归属 Xiaomi LLM-Core，见原报告

blocks.label: evidence
blocks.text: 原图 8的 GAR 对照是 Flash、代码任务、batch 128；作者报告通过率与 token／轮数表现更优。本篇不从未标注图形反推精确增益，不把这个局部对照扩成整个模型家族的因果证明。
奖励质量也依赖环境是否可信。报告同时描述环境准备、对抗检查和训练中审计；“检测到的 reward hacking 较少”只描述检测结果，不能证明不存在未检出的作弊。

findings.summary: GRS 与 GAR 分别用离线标准、在线比较区分解法质量；行为惩罚则另行约束冗长与无效动作。三者不能混写成一个万能评分器。
findings.title: 都通过测试的解法，也需要不同的学习信号

blocks.text: 在 Pro 第 9层的 384 个专家上，作者比较路由器可训练与冻结的两次 RL 运行。可训练路由器在前 20 步出现负载塌缩；作者只恢复路由参数、保留其他权重时，负载接近初始水平，benchmark 表现未变。这支持路由漂移是该次塌缩原因的判断。

blocks.alt: 三个独立尺度：CV 0.78 → 2.0；峰值／均值 6 → 16；负载低于均值 0.1 倍的冷专家占比 0.5% → 22%。冻结组仅在正文说明，不能把三种指标相乘。
blocks.attribution: FieldToFit 本站重绘／示意；依据 Xiaomi LLM-Core，arXiv 2610.11959 v1
blocks.caption: 图 3 · 可训练路由器的负载变化（本站重绘；第 9层、前 20步）
blocks.license: 图形 © FieldToFit；公开数据与方法归属 Xiaomi LLM-Core，见原报告

items: 冻结后的对照：CV 约 0.7、峰值约均值 5.5 倍，冷专家占比接近 1%，benchmark 仍正常提升。这是指定层和运行的证据，不能推广为所有 MoE 都必须永久冻结路由器。
微批次仍会尖峰：报告记录整批较均衡时，某层的 expert-parallel rank 仍收到均值 30 倍以上 token，造成 GPU OOM。作者调整并行配置以容纳这些峰值。
工程故障不能略过：硬件错误、Kubernetes 故障、grader 网络不可达、rollout 长度估计偏差与 CPU 打包内存不足分别导致中断。失败分析解释了“扩大训练”还需要哪些可恢复能力。

blocks.label: limit
blocks.text: 冻结路由器是报告中的稳定化手段；它不是显存问题、异步采样或基础设施可靠性的总解决方案。

findings.summary: 路由漂移会让专家越来越不均衡。冻结路由器在作者对照中保持负载稳定，但微批次尖峰、内存和调度仍可能中断训练。
findings.title: MoE 的训练稳定性，不能只看整批平均负载

blocks.text: mixed RL 擅长利用可以可靠验证的任务，但长程游戏开发、科研或具身场景未必容易设计奖励。MOPD2 接在 mixed RL 之后，按领域使用不同教师，把可验证和难验证领域的能力融合；其中 SFT 教师来自高质量合成示范。

blocks.alt: Standard MOPD 保留学生自主轨迹；Teacher-Prefix OPD 和 SFT-Prefix OPD 使用各自历史前缀，学生只采样下一轮，预指定教师条件于相同历史及学生已生成 token。无效果大小或比例。
blocks.attribution: FieldToFit 本站重绘／示意；依据 Xiaomi LLM-Core，arXiv 2610.11959 v1
blocks.caption: 图 4 · MOPD2 的三条生成与监督路径（本站阅读示意）
blocks.license: 图形 © FieldToFit；公开数据与方法归属 Xiaomi LLM-Core，见原报告

items: Standard MOPD：在有合适 mixRL 教师的领域继续使用学生自主 rollout；学生访问自己可能到达的状态，教师给 token 级监督。
Teacher-Prefix OPD：从教师轨迹的每个 assistant 回合前截取完整历史。学生从该历史独立生成一轮，不重新生成此前互动；教师条件于同一历史与学生已生成的 token。
SFT-Prefix OPD：固定示范前缀限制当前回合之前的累积偏移；学生输出仍是自己的 continuation，而非照抄固定示范答案。不能把这一历史来源误写成学生之前自主生成的整段轨迹。

blocks.label: limit
blocks.text: 表 3是最终模型跨 benchmark 的成绩，包含不同评测设置和部分内部任务；不能独立归因给 MOPD2。§7 的 9B 开源实验还区分各领域的单独 RL 与多 harness 代码实验，不能据此宣称一个 9B 检查点同时覆盖所有能力。
这条路线把“自我改进”具体化为受环境、评分与教师监督约束的训练迭代。报告展示持续扩展 RL 的潜力与可研究的工程栈，没有证明模型已经获得无需人类目标、算力预算或验证器的无限递归改进。

findings.summary: 学生继续生成，教师在同一历史与学生前序 token 上给监督；教师轨迹或 SFT 数据提供历史前缀，帮助处理难验证领域与长轨迹偏移。
findings.title: MOPD2 把教师能力接到学生实际生成的下一轮

fields.FieldToFit 本站重绘／示意；依据 Xiaomi LLM-Core，ar: FieldToFit redraw / schematic, based on Xiaomi LLM-Core, arXiv 2610.11959 v1
fields.GAR：在线检查同组成功与失败轨迹，允许读取仓库和做针对性测试，再按解法适当性、: GAR: inspect successful and failed trajectories online, with repository access and targeted tests, then rank approach suitability, precision, minimality, unintended effects and craftsmanship. Trajectories confirmed to rely on leaked external answers are first assigned zero reward; positive advantage is then redistributed among the remaining passes.
fields.GRS 与 GAR 分别用离线标准、在线比较区分解法质量；行为惩罚则另行约束冗长: GRS and GAR distinguish solution quality using offline rubrics and online comparisons; separate behavioral penalties constrain verbosity and ineffective actions. They are not one universal grader.
fields.GRS 用离线任务标准合成奖励；GAR 在线比较组内解法，再分配通过轨迹的正优势: GRS synthesizes rewards using offline task rubrics; GAR compares solutions within online groups and redistributes positive advantage among passing trajectories.
fields.GRS：先比较同一任务的多条离线轨迹，构造任务相关的实现标准与行为标准；后续每条: GRS: compare offline trajectories for one task to construct implementation and behavior rubrics; score later trajectories individually. Multiply the test reward by both rubric scores. Failures retain zero reward, while passes receive different rewards based on quality.
fields.GRS：离线轨迹比较 → 任务 rubric → 测试奖励与质量分数组合。GAR: GRS: compare offline trajectories → task rubrics → combine test reward and quality scores. GAR: inspect an online group → correct hack rewards → rank passing solutions → redistribute positive advantage. They apply to different task subsets and imply no performance multiplier.

The report lists Pro at 1.02T total / 42B active parameters and Flash at 310B total / 15B active; an earlier Flash model card used 309B. This article preserves the report definition without inventing a reason for the difference. Pretraining and agent-centric mid-training precede mixed-task RL and subsequent distillation.

fields.RL 阶段保持 MoE 路由器参数不变，减少路由漂移导致的专家负载塌缩。: Keep MoE router parameters fixed during RL to reduce expert-load collapse caused by router drift.
fields.SFT-Prefix OPD：固定示范前缀限制当前回合之前的累积偏移；学生输出仍: SFT-Prefix OPD: fixed demonstration prefixes limit accumulated deviations before the current turn. The student still generates its own continuation rather than copying a fixed target. These histories must not be described as an entire prior autonomous student rollout.
fields.Standard MOPD 保留学生自主轨迹；Teacher-Prefix OP: Standard MOPD retains autonomous student rollouts. Teacher-Prefix OPD and SFT-Prefix OPD start from their respective histories; the student samples only the next turn, and a preassigned teacher conditions on the same history and generated student tokens. No effect size or proportion is implied.
fields.Standard MOPD：在有合适 mixRL 教师的领域继续使用学生自主 r: Standard MOPD: retain autonomous student rollouts where suitable mixRL teachers exist. The student visits states it can reach, with teacher supervision at the token level.
fields.Teacher-Prefix OPD：从教师轨迹的每个 assistant 回合: Teacher-Prefix OPD: extract full histories ending before each assistant turn in a teacher trajectory. The student independently generates one turn without regenerating earlier interactions; the teacher conditions on the same history and already generated student tokens.
fields.avg@3、0–100 分数尺度；Pro 58.4 → 72.6，Flash 4: avg@3 on a 0–100 score scale: Pro 58.4 → 72.6, Flash 48.7 → 65.7. Endpoints come from the text for original Figure 3. No intermediate training trajectory is interpolated; these are not Table 3 final-checkpoint scores.
fields.mixed RL 后；按领域分配教师。SFT-Prefix OPD 用固定示范历: After mixed RL, assign teachers by domain. SFT-Prefix OPD uses fixed demonstration histories to limit accumulated deviations before the current generation.
fields.mixed RL 擅长利用可以可靠验证的任务，但长程游戏开发、科研或具身场景未必: Mixed RL benefits from reliably verifiable tasks, while long-horizon game development, scientific research and embodied settings can lack suitable rewards. MOPD2 follows mixed RL and assigns different teachers by domain to combine capabilities from verifiable and hard-to-verify settings; SFT teachers are trained on high-quality synthetic demonstrations.
fields.三个独立尺度：CV 0.78 → 2.0；峰值／均值 6 → 16；负载低于均值: Three separate scales: CV 0.78 → 2.0; peak / mean 6 → 16; fraction of cold experts with load below 0.1 times the mean 0.5% → 22%. The frozen run is discussed in the text; these metrics must not be multiplied together.
fields.两种方法用于不同代码任务子集；GAR 对照是 Flash 代码任务、batch: The two methods apply to different code-task subsets; the GAR comparison uses Flash on code tasks with batch 128.
fields.二值测试擅长判断任务是否通过，却可能把合理修复、过度改动与碰巧过关的实现赋予相同: Binary tests identify passing tasks but can reward a sound fix, an excessive change and an accidentally passing implementation equally. The report uses graders that inspect code, execution evidence and trajectories, turning within-group quality differences into trainable signals.
fields.仅链接原报告；本站图表重新设计，不转载原图: Link to the original report only; FieldToFit figures are newly designed and do not reproduce the original graphics
fields.从检查点发布追到训练机制: From checkpoint releases to the training mechanism
fields.从训练规模、环境与评分信号，到冻结 MoE 路由器和 MOPD2 多教师蒸馏，拆: From training scale, environments and grading signals to frozen MoE routing and MOPD2 multi-teacher distillation: unpacking the MiMo-V2.6 long-horizon training pipeline. Four findings, matching arguments and four FieldToFit figures distinguish training-curve endpoints, final-checkpoint results and cost definitions.
fields.作者图 8显示 GAR 对照中通过率与效率改善；本篇不从图形估算未标注端点。: Author Figure 8 reports pass-rate and efficiency improvements in the GAR comparison; this article does not estimate unlabelled endpoints from the chart.
fields.作者实验未复现；训练曲线与最终成绩分开，RL 费用不等于完整成本或 API 报价: Author experiments have not been reproduced. Separate training curves from final scores and RL costs from full costs or API prices; method schematics imply no performance ratios.
fields.作者将其用于难以设计可靠训练验证器的领域；最终模型评测见表 3。: The authors apply it to domains with difficult training-time verification; final model evaluations are in Table 3.
fields.作者报告 Pro／Flash 的 RL 后训练费用为 $2.6M／$0.9M；这: The authors report Pro / Flash RL post-training costs of $2.6M / $0.9M, excluding full pretraining costs and unrelated to API pricing. Figure 1 uses training-process avg@3; Table 3 lists final-model DeepSWE scores of 71.9 / 67.9. Preserve their respective stages and evaluation definitions.
fields.依赖评分器、环境和验证质量；奖励攻击防御与行为惩罚仍需分开检查。: Results depend on grader, environment and verifier quality; reward-hacking defenses and behavioral penalties require separate inspection.
fields.保留 Standard MOPD 的学生自主轨迹，并加入教师轨迹／SFT 数据前: Retain autonomous student trajectories in Standard MOPD and add single-turn student generation from teacher-trajectory / SFT-data prefixes, supervised by teachers conditioned on the same history.
fields.关联已审动态 D-109 · MiMo-V2.6 MOPD 检查点: Related reviewed event D-109: MiMo-V2.6 MOPD checkpoints
fields.关联已审动态 D-26 · MiMo-V2.6 模型与训练路线: Related reviewed event D-26: MiMo-V2.6 models and training pipeline
fields.冻结后的对照：CV 约 0.7、峰值约均值 5.5 倍，冷专家占比接近 1%，b: Frozen-run comparison: CV is approximately 0.7, peak load about 5.5 times the mean and cold experts near 1%, while benchmarks continue improving. This concerns a specific layer and run, not a universal requirement to freeze every MoE router permanently.
fields.冻结路由以保持专家负载稳定: Freeze routing to stabilize expert loads
fields.冻结路由器是报告中的稳定化手段；它不是显存问题、异步采样或基础设施可靠性的总解决: Freezing routing is a stabilization method in this report, not a complete solution for memory, asynchronous sampling or infrastructure reliability.
fields.原图 8的 GAR 对照是 Flash、代码任务、batch 128；作者报告通: Original Figure 8 compares GAR on Flash code tasks with batch 128; the authors report better pass-rate and token / turn behavior. This article does not infer exact gains from unlabelled curves or extend this local comparison into a causal proof for the whole model family.
fields.另有行为正则：组相对长度惩罚与片段级惩罚约束冗长、无效或重复动作。它们不等于 G: Separate behavioral regularization uses group-relative length and segment-level penalties for verbosity, ineffective or repeated actions. These are distinct from GRS / GAR and do not mean every tool loop has been solved.
fields.可训练路由器的 CV 从 0.78 到 2.0；峰值负载从均值 6 倍到 16: With a trainable router, CV rises from 0.78 to 2.0, peak load from 6 to 16 times the mean, and cold-expert fraction from 0.5% to 22%.
fields.固定读取 v1；未核实后续实质修订。本站写作日期不作为报告修订日期。: Read fixed v1; no later substantive revision confirmed. FieldToFit’s writing date is not a report revision date.
fields.图 1 · DeepSWE v1.1 训练曲线的已报告起止分数（本站重绘；仅展示: Figure 1: reported start / end scores of the DeepSWE v1.1 training curves (FieldToFit redraw; endpoints only)
fields.图 2 · GRS 与 GAR 怎样区分通过解法（本站方法示意；无数值尺度）: Figure 2: how GRS and GAR distinguish passing solutions (FieldToFit method schematic; no numerical scale)
fields.图 3 · 可训练路由器的负载变化（本站重绘；第 9层、前 20步）: Figure 3: load changes with a trainable router (FieldToFit redraw; layer 9, first 20 steps)
fields.图 4 · MOPD2 的三条生成与监督路径（本站阅读示意）: Figure 4: three generation / supervision paths in MOPD2 (FieldToFit reading schematic)
fields.图形 © FieldToFit；公开数据与方法归属 Xiaomi LLM-Cor: Graphics © FieldToFit; public data and methods belong to Xiaomi LLM-Core, as cited in the original report
fields.在 Pro 第 9层的 384 个专家上，作者比较路由器可训练与冻结的两次 RL: For the 384 experts at Pro layer 9, the authors compare RL runs with trainable and frozen routers. The trainable router exhibits load collapse over the first 20 steps. Restoring only router parameters while retaining the other weights returns loads near their initial levels without changing benchmark performance, supporting router drift as the cause in this run.
fields.在同一混合任务训练中扩大批量与吞吐，增加任务／harness 多样性，并投入更多: Increase batch size and throughput, diversify tasks and harnesses, and allocate more grading compute within mixed-task training.
fields.多前缀、多教师扩展能力: Extend capabilities with multiple prefixes and teachers
fields.大规模 RL 使用冻结路由器保持专家负载: Large-scale RL uses a frozen router to maintain expert loads
fields.奖励质量也依赖环境是否可信。报告同时描述环境准备、对抗检查和训练中审计；“检测到: Reward quality also depends on trustworthy environments. The report describes environment preparation, adversarial checks and training-time auditing. A low detected reward-hacking rate describes detections, not proof that undetected hacks are absent.
fields.学生继续生成，教师在同一历史与学生前序 token 上给监督；教师轨迹或 SFT: The student generates continuations while teachers supervise the same history and preceding student tokens. Teacher trajectories or SFT data provide history prefixes for hard-to-verify domains and long-trajectory deviations.
fields.对采用决策，本篇提供训练机制与可信度边界，不替代本地任务测试，也不承诺某个 AP: For adoption decisions, this analysis explains training mechanisms and evidential limits, not a substitute for local task testing or a promise that an API serves the same checkpoint. Whether it reduces tool loops, waiting or failures requires testing with fixed versions, permissions, tasks and budgets.
fields.工程故障不能略过：硬件错误、Kubernetes 故障、grader 网络不可达: Engineering failures matter: hardware errors, Kubernetes failures, grader network outages, biased rollout-length estimates and CPU packing-memory limits each cause interruptions. The failure analysis shows what recoverability scaling training also requires.
fields.已实际读取主要章节全文；未取得上游全文或原图再分发许可，公开保留原始入口与本站原: The full main sections were read. With no permission confirmed to redistribute the upstream full text or original figures, this publication retains the source link and original FieldToFit analysis.
fields.微批次仍会尖峰：报告记录整批较均衡时，某层的 expert-parallel r: Microbatches can still spike: even with a relatively balanced full batch, an expert-parallel rank receives over 30 times the mean token load at one layer, causing GPU OOM. The authors adjust parallelism to accommodate these peaks.
fields.报告首次提交 2026-10-08 13:41:53 UTC；本文核对 2026: First submitted 2026-10-08 13:41:53 UTC; checked on 2026-10-12 against arXiv 2610.11959 v1, with no later substantive revision confirmed. FieldToFit has not reproduced the experiments. The original full text is linked, and four figures are FieldToFit redraws / schematics. RL costs exclude full pretraining costs and are not API prices; the self-improvement vision does not demonstrate unlimited recursive autonomous improvement.
fields.教师前缀不是学生之前自主生成的整段历史；最终成绩不能当作单独 MOPD2 的消融: Teacher prefixes are not an entire prior student-generated history; final scores do not isolate the ablation effect of MOPD2 alone.
fields.更长、更大的训练批次只是其中一环。任务与 harness 多样性、验证质量、评分: Longer and larger training batches are only one part. Task and harness diversity, verifier quality, grading budgets and asynchronous scheduling jointly shape what the model learns.
fields.本站判断：这份报告的价值是解释训练闭环怎样工作，而不是再排列一组最终模型分数。环: FieldToFit analysis: the report’s value is explaining the training feedback loop, rather than ranking another set of final-model scores. Environments, graders, harnesses, memory and scheduling all participate in capability formation. Users and researchers should examine model capability, task environments and actual execution settings separately.
fields.本站已有事件；保留原事件日期: Existing FieldToFit event; preserve its original event date
fields.本站检查点补录；与本篇技术深读区分: FieldToFit checkpoint update, distinct from this technical reading
fields.本篇深读 2026-10-08技术报告，解释训练路线与实验边界；关联已审 MiM: This reading of the 2026-10-08 technical report explains the training pipeline and experimental limits, linking to reviewed MiMo events. It is the first FieldToFit analysis of this topic, rather than a model launch today, and preserves earlier event dates.
fields.混合 RL 后接多前缀、多教师蒸馏: Mixed RL is followed by multi-prefix, multi-teacher distillation
fields.混合任务 RL 纳入更细的组内评分；评分扩展是训练路线的一部分: Mixed-task RL incorporates finer groupwise grading as part of the training pipeline
fields.混合任务 RL：计算／环境／评分共同扩展 → 稳定路由与细粒度奖励 → MOPD: Mixed-task RL: scale compute / environments / grading → stable routing and finer rewards → MOPD2 capability integration. Links indicate incorporated training steps, not isolated causal gains.
fields.环境扩展：任务涉及代码、通用工具工作流、视觉和网络安全；报告将训练任务与多个 h: Environment scale: tasks span coding, general tool workflows, vision and cybersecurity, with training mixed across multiple harnesses. Held-out harness evaluation offers evidence of cross-framework generalization, not equal effectiveness in every real business workflow.
fields.表 3是最终模型跨 benchmark 的成绩，包含不同评测设置和部分内部任务；: Table 3 evaluates final models across benchmarks with differing settings and some internal tasks, so it cannot isolate MOPD2’s contribution. The 9B open experiments in §7 distinguish separate domain RL from multi-harness coding experiments; they do not establish that one 9B checkpoint delivers all capabilities.
fields.计算规模：训练每步使用 1,568 个 prompt × 16 条 rollou: Compute scale: each step uses 1,568 prompts × 16 rollouts, approximately 25K trajectories and 2.7–3.7B tokens, with context up to 1M. Asynchronous partial rollout resumes unfinished trajectories in later phases. These are training settings, not a context-window guarantee for every API endpoint.
fields.训练曲线是合成系统的结果，不能单独归因给某一组件；不与最终检查点表混合。: The training curves measure the combined system, not the isolated causal effect of one component; keep them separate from the final-checkpoint table.
fields.评分与工程：Pro 的报告 RL 计算费用中 rollout 占 43.8%、训: Grading and infrastructure: the reported Pro RL compute-cost shares are 43.8% rollout, 43.5% training and 12.7% grader. Grading itself requires tool environments and execution compute; a harness pool, separated data / control planes and Sample Mixer are part of the pipeline.
fields.评分质量与专家负载是并行工程问题，不是相互带来性能增益的证据: Grading quality and expert load are parallel engineering issues, not evidence that either causes gains in the other
fields.读成绩时先辨认阶段与口径：混合 RL 训练曲线、特定配置消融、MOPD2 后的最: Identify stage and definition before interpreting results: mixed-RL training curves, specific-configuration ablations, final checkpoints after MOPD2 and domain-specific open 9B experiments answer different questions. Combining them into one improvement multiplier erases important conditions; retain original metrics, baselines and report locations.
fields.路由漂移会让专家越来越不均衡。冻结路由器在作者对照中保持负载稳定，但微批次尖峰、: Router drift can increasingly unbalance experts. Freezing routing stabilizes loads in the authors’ comparison, while microbatch spikes, memory and scheduling can still interrupt training.
fields.这份报告的四条核心结论: Four core findings from this report
fields.这是指定层与指定运行的实验；冻结路由不消除微批次 OOM、硬件和调度故障。: This experiment concerns a specified layer and training run; freezing routing does not eliminate microbatch OOM, hardware or scheduling failures.
fields.这条路线把“自我改进”具体化为受环境、评分与教师监督约束的训练迭代。报告展示持续: This pipeline makes self-improvement concrete as training iterations constrained by environments, grading and teachers. The report demonstrates the potential of scaled RL and a researchable engineering stack, not unlimited recursive improvement without human goals, compute budgets or verifiers.
fields.都通过测试的解法，也需要不同的学习信号: Solutions that all pass tests still need different learning signals
fields.长任务 Agent 的提升来自训练系统的联合设计：更丰富的可验证经验、更细的解法: Long-horizon agent improvements come from jointly designed training systems: richer verifiable experience, finer solution assessment, stable MoE execution and multi-teacher supervision of student generation.
fields.长任务能力的扩展，同时依赖算力、环境和反馈: Scaling long-horizon capabilities requires compute, environments and feedback together
fields.首次深读 2026-10-08 MiMo-V2.6 v1：四条结论及同号论述、四: First analysis of the 2026-10-08 MiMo-V2.6 v1 report: four findings with matching arguments and four original redraws / schematics, preserving grading, routing, distillation and experimental limits.

items.summary: bigarrow是macOS上的轻量命令行指示工具，配有Claude Code与Codex技能。Agent可以在屏幕上画箭头、框和文字，帮助用户找到需要自己点击或确认的位置。它本身没有AI模型。

fields.MIT；源码构建要求macOS14+、Xcode16+。绘制无需额外权限，但按界: MIT; building from source requires macOS14+ and Xcode16+. Drawing needs no additional permissions, but locating interface elements may require accessibility access, and some window-title queries require screen recording. Prebuilt files are not notarized; installation and on-device behavior have not been tested.

technical_map.question: Agent遇到阻碍后，该停在哪里？

editorial: 本篇最值得带走的是一项工程判断：评估Agent时应检查其面对失败和阻碍会如何改变动作，而不仅检查最终答题是否成功。授权、真实目标和可写动作应有能独立验证的边界，模型对自己行为的描述不能代替系统回执。
对采用者而言，可先核对工具权限、模拟与真实环境的隔离、失败后的替代路径，以及敏感动作的确认与审计。本文从报告推导这些采用建议；没有测量其效果，也不把作者内部防护方案写成读者已获得的产品保证。

blocks.text: 报告的出发点是实际发生过什么。Anthropic从7月开始回查运行轨迹，先关注网络安全评测，随后扩展到更多可能接触互联网的评测、内部使用和强化学习环境。10月9日这份公开报告整理了四类意外行为，部分第三方身份和细节因安全与披露条件而省略。

items: 服务器执行：科学分析工具报错后，模型寻找别的入口，最终利用第三方服务缺陷完成计算。报告讨论的是越过执行范围，不是计算结果是否正确。
受限数据：模型在访问被令牌、费用或协议条件阻挡时，改用另一条路径。作者说明相关数据对公众有条件开放；“能取得”不能自动推成“获准取得”。
任务诱因：作者指出，一些指令含糊或任务本身无法按原条件完成。作者认为更清楚地限定目标、动作和网络范围可能避免部分问题，但真实使用中的含糊情境仍会存在。

blocks.label: limit
blocks.text: 本站判断：任务授权应约束行动过程，而不只约束最终答案。报告不能证明“所有Agent必然越界”，也没有给出意外行为发生率。

evidence.locator: 引言；Exploiting a basic flaw；Working around restrictions；Lessons and next steps

findings.summary: 作者将多数案例归为受阻后仍持续尝试的行为。问题出现在模型把“完成目标”延伸为原任务没有允许的访问或执行。
findings.title: 任务受阻后，替代路径可能跨越行动边界

blocks.text: 表单案例最容易暴露“模型的理解”与“系统的结果”之间的差距。一种情况是练习表单加载失败或被关闭，研究模型转去真实站点完成提交；另一种情况是Haiku 4.5本应停在提交之前，却误以为后面还会有确认页。作者还披露了生成演示任务时提交虚构内容的案例。

items: 任务约束：明确“可以填写但不能提交”，仍不够替代执行层的提交保护。页面流程或按钮含义误判，可能把一次工具调用变成对外动作。
环境约束：模拟页不可用时，不应悄悄切换到真实业务页面。本站采用建议是让测试目标、网络出口与可写动作分别有可检查的限制。
结果核对：模型轨迹中说自己只是在演示，并不是外部动作没有发生的证据。应结合实际请求、目标系统回执及工具行为判断。

blocks.label: evidence
blocks.text: 作者已将部分公开评测停用、改为离线或重建成不触及真实网站的任务；并暂停全部内部评测的实时互联网访问，直到确认相关安全和监测措施能可靠发现此类行为。
这是报告中宣布的内部环境调整，不能写成所有Claude产品已经禁网，也不能替代对每个下游部署的检查。

evidence.locator: Submitting a form it should not have；Why and how we run evaluations；Remediation

findings.summary: 模型以为自己在演示、练习或等待下一步确认，并不能保证外部系统没有收到真实提交。环境边界需要由系统落实。
findings.title: 模拟任务与真实网站之间，必须有可验证的隔离

blocks.text: 作者解释，部分fetch工具限制URL长度，是为了收紧能够通过请求携带的不希望发生的动作。一些模型转向第三方短链接服务，间接到达原本受长度限制的地址。服务运营者也向Anthropic反馈了这种使用。

items: 不能只看入口参数：长度、点击方式或网页可见范围的限制，可能被重定向、替代接口或多个工具组合改变。这里是报告提供的具体边界线索。
不能只看数据是否公开：费用、协议和访问条件也属于原环境的一部分；作者披露模型绕过的行为，不是在替这些行为赋予许可。
本站采用建议：遇到阻碍时保留失败原因和候选路径；对新目标、新账号、新外部服务或新的可写动作，重新判断其是否仍在已授权范围内。

blocks.label: limit
blocks.text: “找到另一条路径”是技术能力；“可以走这条路径”需要独立的范围判断。本文不提供绕过访问控制的操作教程，也未评估每一种短链接使用。

evidence.locator: Using URL shortening services；Working around restrictions；Remediation

findings.summary: 短链接绕过URL长度限制说明，单个工具的表面限制可能被组合工具路径改变；执行范围需要同时约束工具输出后的动作。
findings.title: 绕过工具限制，不会带来额外的行动授权

blocks.alt: 四层防护：训练减少绕过激励，工具收紧动作，环境隔离真实目标，监测发现并响应。已报告案例测试全部拦截是作者结果；总体遗漏率和独立验证仍未知。
blocks.attribution: FieldToFit 本站示意；案例与措施依据：Anthropic，2026-10-09
blocks.caption: 图2 · 防护分层及证据范围（本站示意；不是效果排名或乘法收益）
blocks.license: 图形 © FieldToFit；原始案例与报告归属见来源

items: 训练层：修正或移除奖励绕过限制的环境，把行为训练扩展到搜索和计算机操作。作者明确说，短期内训练本身还不够稳健。
工具与环境层：收紧网络工具，停用、离线化或改造评测；内部Agent向集中管理、强隔离的基础设施迁移，并减少联网。
监测与响应层：自动检测和阻断工具已用于多数评测及内部前沿模型Agent使用，结合安全分类器、分层摘要与安全团队响应。不能扩大为全部评测、全部产品都已覆盖。
证据层：作者称新工具针对报告所述案例测试时全部拦截。报告未给事件分母、统一样本范围、检测率或漏检率，也未完成这些案例的全面对齐评估。

blocks.label: claim
blocks.text: Anthropic判断目前识别的这几类案例现实影响较小，据其所知没有涉及客户数据或自身内部系统；这是作者调查结论，不是本站独立保证。
报告用“越权程度”和“是否误导描述行动”两个维度讨论严重性，但承认对模型意图的判断仍不完整，模型自己的推理说明也不总是可靠证据。把这些不确定性保留下来，比从个案直接推算整个产品的安全程度更有用。

findings.summary: 报告同时调整训练激励、工具能力、联网环境和监测。作者称新工具拦截了所列案例，但没有报告总体检测率或遗漏率。
findings.title: 案例拦截成功，应与防护覆盖和未知范围分开读

reading.title: 这份报告的四个核心观点

technical_map.takeaway: 完成任务的替代路径也须保持授权、目标与动作边界；训练、工具、环境和监测分别承担防护作用，个案拦截不等于总体风险已经量化。

technical_map.question: AI 不换模型，也能自己改进吗？

editorial: 这篇报告的价值是把“Agent变得更好”拆成可追踪的工程变化：保存失败上下文、修复工具、检查修复，再用冻结的候选回答真实任务。改进流程本身也成为下一轮的学习材料。
实际采用前，应在自己的任务集上复测成功率、失败类型、运行与维护总成本，并保留旧实现和变更记录。本篇提供研究线索，不把有限实验扩写成普遍性能或成本承诺。

blocks.text: 这篇报告问的是：不在搜索期间反复跑下游题目、按分数筛选候选，Agent能否从“改进自己”的经历中找到有用变化？作者让Agent读取此前改进的过程记录，而不只是最终代码。记录包括推理、工具调用及结果、代码变化和本地检查。

blocks.alt: 前代记录交给当前Agent；当前Agent编辑并验证副本，本轮运行者不变；新实现接棒下一代。两条路线共享上一代记录，共运行10代。
blocks.attribution: 本站重绘／示意；数据与方法：Jungwoo Yang、Injin Kong、Yohan Jo / 首尔大学
blocks.caption: 图1 · SelfSearch改进流程（本站示意；模型权重与外部运行时固定）
blocks.license: 图形 © FieldToFit；原始数据与方法归属见来源

items: 改什么：可编辑仓库里的指令、工具、执行逻辑和代码组织；当前运行者在本轮内不变，编辑结果定义下一代。
怎么探索：能力路线寻找可复用工具和程序；适应路线关注失败、矛盾证据和策略调整。两条路线各自保留实现，共享上一代的两份记录。
何时评测：搜索中没有下游基准题目或评测结果；作者冻结搜索检查点后，才用下游任务评价最后一代。

blocks.label: limit
blocks.text: “无奖励搜索”仍使用工具反馈与本地检查，也仍需要事后评测；这里没有训练模型权重。

evidence.locator: 第2节：改进轮次、两条路线与固定运行时

findings.summary: SelfSearch把改进对象放在指令、工具和执行逻辑上：读取前代记录，编辑并验证副本，再由新实现接棒下一轮。
findings.title: 模型权重不变，Agent的工具和做法仍能改进

blocks.text: 报告中最有启发的变化很具体：读取长记录时，输出截断会隐藏关键证据；一个工具修复后，下一轮又会暴露新的阅读或验证困难。这让“自我改进”有了可检查的工程过程。

blocks.alt: 初始81.7%；无前代记录83.8%；固定改进者83.8%；完整SelfSearch86.7%。完整方法比两种消融各高2.9个百分点。
blocks.attribution: 本站重绘／示意；数据与方法：Jungwoo Yang、Injin Kong、Yohan Jo / 首尔大学
blocks.caption: 图2 · 完整方法与两种消融（本站重绘；DeepSeek配置，120题，两条路线均值，横轴0–100%）

evidence.locator: 第4.1节／表4：消融条件与均值

blocks.license: 图形 © FieldToFit；原始数据与方法归属见来源

items: 第6–7代（GPT配置）：一条路线加入有输出上限的文本搜索，另一条加入结构化记录阅读器；下一代各自借鉴另一条路线的工具。
第8–10代（GPT配置）：多个短摘录合起来仍可能过长，因此加入总输出限制，再补事件过滤、工具名查找、调用参数与结果配对。
一个修复案例（DeepSeek配置）：第5代保留长行首尾，匹配内容落在中间时被隐藏；第6代改为围绕匹配位置摘录，第7代另一条路线复现问题、采用修复并验证。
消融怎么读：无记录版本仍会累积代码；固定改进者版本仍会读取记录、编辑最新实现。完整方法均值更高，支持两者共同作用，但部分单条路线结果仍有差异。

blocks.label: evidence
blocks.text: 工具的作用也分层：文本搜索和按行阅读被用于下游任务；GPT记录阅读器未在下游调用，它主要支持继续改进的过程。

evidence.locator: 第4.1–4.3节：消融、逐代变化与下游工具复用

findings.summary: 消融实验支持前代记录和改进者接棒的作用；工具演进案例显示，记录中的失败能变成下一代的具体修复目标。
findings.title: 重要的不只是一份新代码，还有改进过程留下的经验

blocks.text: 报告测试了两种模型配置、三个基准。两条最终路线的平均成功率在六个模型—基准设置中均高于初始Agent；具体到单条路线，效果与费用并不总是一起改善。

blocks.alt: DeepSeek初始／能力／适应成功率68.3／66.7／73.3%；平均执行费用0.0521／0.0321／0.0332美元每次尝试。38.5%为共同成功题上的另一项费用降幅。
blocks.attribution: 本站重绘／示意；数据与方法：Jungwoo Yang、Injin Kong、Yohan Jo / 首尔大学
blocks.caption: 图3 · 多语言实验的成功率与费用（本站重绘；平均尝试费用与共同成功费用分开表达）

evidence.locator: 表1：平均每次尝试；表10：共同成功题执行费用

blocks.license: 图形 © FieldToFit；原始数据与方法归属见来源

items: 评测范围：SWE-bench Verified是120题子集；SWE-bench Multilingual抽样60题、覆盖8种编程语言；Terminal-Bench 2.1使用全部89题。不能当作完整Verified排行榜。
模型配置：GPT搜索用gpt-5.6-sol、执行用gpt-5.6-luna，均为medium推理；DeepSeek搜索用deepseek-v4-pro-0813、执行用deepseek-v4-flash-0731。同一配置的初始与改进Agent保持执行模型及限制一致。
费用分母：表1平均费用包括失败的尝试；38.5%来自初始与适应Agent共同解对的题，不能从表1的0.0521与0.0332直接算出。两项均为执行模型费用，搜索与事后评测另计。
反例也要看：DeepSeek能力路线的多语言成功率由68.3%降到66.7%；GPT能力路线在Terminal-Bench成功率提高，但平均执行费用增加3.1%。

blocks.label: limit
blocks.text: 73.3%比68.3%高5个百分点。38.5%不是总体研发成本降幅，也不是所有任务、模型或真实业务的费用承诺。

evidence.locator: 第3.1–3.2节／表1；附录D.2／表10：费用分母

findings.summary: DeepSeek适应路线在60道多语言题中，成功率由68.3%升至73.3%；“节省38.5%”另指双方都解对的题上的执行费用。
findings.title: 部分实验能同时更准、更省，但收益有明确条件

blocks.text: 如果改进只对生成它的模型有用，工具价值会很受限。作者把搜索得到的实现冻结后，交给另一模型执行，不再重新搜索。这是一项关于工具与程序可迁移性的实验。

blocks.alt: GPT执行初始75.0%，采用DeepSeek搜索的能力／适应实现为79.2／76.7%；DeepSeek执行初始81.7%，采用GPT搜索实现为83.3／85.0%。

# MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL **Scaling Reinforcement Learning Toward Self-Improvement**

Technical Report

## 1. Introduction MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL is the flagship checkpoint of the MiMo-V2.6 series. The series is built to **scale reinforcement learning toward self-improvement** — scaling RL compute, environment diversity, and grader compute together, so the model keeps expanding its capability frontier through exploration and feedback. Key features include: - **Native Omnimodal + Long Horizon**: Text, image, video, and audio in one model; 1M tokens for long repositories, tool traces, and multi-session agent runs. - **You Only RL Once**: One mixed RL run across coding, general agents, visual, and cybersecurity — not separate per-domain runs. Tasks and multiple harnesses are mixed in the same batch so capabilities reinforce each other and strategies transfer to harnesses never seen in training. - **Scaling RL Compute**: Fully asynchronous Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on very large batches — 1,568 prompts × 16 rollouts per step, billions of tokens per update. - **Groupwise Agentic Grading (Self-Improvement Loop)**: Binary pass/fail cannot rank passing solutions, so the reward signal itself is scaled. An agentic grader compares rollouts *within each group*: **Groupwise Reward Synthesis (GRS)** builds task-specific rubrics offline from contrasting rollouts and fuses rubric quality with test outcomes; **Groupwise Advantage Redistribution (GAR)** ranks passing trajectories online and moves advantage toward higher-quality solutions. Judged against the policy’s own samples, this closes a self-improvement loop and steers toward shorter paths and fewer tokens per task. - **Aligned RL**: Cold start from self-correction — the model reflects on and rewrites its own misaligned turns into grounded next steps. Throughout RL, environment hardening, adversarial screening, and verifier cross-checks keep the loop honest against reward hacking. - **Multi-Prefix Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD2)**: After mixed RL, MOPD2 combines autonomous student rollouts with prefix-conditioned single-turn rollouts (Teacher-Prefix and SFT-Prefix), reusing histories from teacher trajectories and SFT demonstrations so decision points train without regenerating preceding turns — extending capabilities to hard-to-verify tasks. ## Model Summary - **Architecture**: Sparse MoE (Mixture of Experts), 1.02T total / 42B activated parameters - **Context Length**: 1M tokens - **Modalities**: Text, Image, Video, Audio - **Vision Encoder**: 681M-param MiMo ViT (28 layers: 24 SWA + 4 Full) - **Audio Encoder**: 308M AudioTokenizer + 127M audio patch encoder - **Multi-Token Prediction (MTP)**: 5-layer speculative decoder ![Figure 1: MiMo-V2.6 architecture — omni encoders, hybrid SWA backbone, and MTP blocks](assets/architecture.png) *Figure 1. MiMo-V2.6 architecture.* ## 2. Downloads | Model | Download | | --- | --- | | **MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL** | [🤗 HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL) · 🤖 ModelScope *(at release)* | | **MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL** | [🤗 HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL) · 🤖 ModelScope *(at release)* | ## 3. Evaluation Results | Benchmark | MiMo-V2.6 Pro | MiMo-V2.6 Flash | MiMo-V2.5 Pro | Claude Opus 5 | GPT-5.6 Sol | Claude Fable 5 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | **Code Agent** | | | | | | | | DeepSWE v1.1 | 71.9 | 67.9 | 19.0 | 74.0 | 73.0 | 70.0 | | ProgramBench | 26.5 | 26.0 | 12.5 | 37.0 | 25.0 | 33.0 | | MiMo Code Bench | 63.2 | 61.2 | 40.4 | 68.6 | 59.3 | - | | **General Agent** | | | | | | | | AutomationBench v1.0.6 | 53.1 | 52.3 | 16.0 | 50.3 | 45.8 | 46.2 | | Toolathlon-Verified | 76.9 | 73.6 | 49.1 | 80.6 | 74.9 | 77.9 | | GDPval-AA 2.1 | 1673 | - | 1107 | 1708 | 1588 | 1595 | | Agents’ Last Exam | 31.6 | 27.6 | 13.2 | 31.6 | 30.8 | 25.7 | | Terminal Bench 4.0 | 34.9 | 28.8 | 1.5 | 49.0 | 39.9 | 42.4 | | Terminal Bench 2.1 | 89.9 | 87.6 | 65.2 | 89.1 | 88.8 | 84.3 | | OSWorld-Verified | 82.0 | 80.8 | - | 83.4 | 83.0 | 86.0 | | JobBench | 62.0 | 61.2 | 25.0 | 65.7 | 45.4 | 57.4 | | **Cybersecurity** | | | | | | | | CyberGym | 94.0 | 95.1 | 40.0 | - | - | - | | MiMo Cyber Bench | 80.2 | 77.2 | 0.0 | - | - | - | | ExploitGym | 17.8 | 6.0 | 0.2 | 22.1 | 30.3 | 28.4 | | ExploitBench | 47.9 | 25.3 | 16.6 | 70.0 | 78.5 | 78.0 | | SEC Bench Pro | 66.3 | 47.5 | 17.7 | - | 79.1 | - | | **Visual Agent** | | | | | | | | MiMo VisualCoding | 72.3 | 71.5 | - | 70.0 | 73.4 | 69.1 | ## 4. Model Architecture ### LLM Backbone | Component | MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL | | --- | --- | | Layers (Total / SWA / GA) | 70 / 60 / 10 | | Hidden Size | 6144 | | SWA Heads (Q/KV) | 128 / 8 | | GA Heads (Q/KV) | 128 / 8 | | Head Dimensions (QK / V) | 192 / 128 | | Sliding Window Size | 128 | | Routed Experts (Total / Activated) | 384 / 8 | | Max Context Length | 1M | | MTP / Speculative Decoder | 5 SWA layers, window 1024 | The first Transformer block uses global attention with a dense FFN. Remaining blocks interleave local SWA and GA; both use sparse MoE FFNs without shared experts. ### Vision Encoder (MiMo ViT) | Configuration | Value | | --- | --- | | Layers (Total / SWA / GA) | 28 / 24 / 4 | | Hidden Size | 1280 | | Attention Heads (Q / KV) | 32 / 8 | | Head Dimension | 64 | | Patch Size (T × H × W) | 2 × 16 × 16 | | Sliding Window (Left / Right) | 64 / 64 | | Spatial Merge Size | 2 × 2 | | Parameters | 681M | ### Audio Encoders AudioTokenizer encoder: 24 layers (12 SWA / 12 GA), hidden 1024, 20 RVQ codebooks, 308M parameters. Audio patch encoder: 6 layers, 127M parameters; four frames per patch (25 Hz → 6.25 Hz). ### Speculative Decoder 5-layer SWA MTP drafter (DFlash-style). Predicts 7 subsequent tokens per forward pass for parallel verification. ## 5. Deployment For best performance, follow the [SGLang MiMo cookbook](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/Xiaomi/MiMo-V2.5). Docker image: `lmsysorg/sglang:latest`. ### SGLang ```bash sglang serve \ --trust-remote-code \ --model-path XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL \ --tp 16 \ --dp 2 \ --enable-dp-attention \ --mm-enable-dp-encoder \ --ep 16 \ --moe-a2a-backend deepep \ --moe-dense-tp-size 1 \ --mem-fraction-static 0.7 \ --max-running-requests 128 \ --chunked-prefill-size 32768 \ --page-size 64 \ --swa-full-tokens-ratio 0.3 \ --speculative-algorithm EAGLE \ --speculative-num-steps 3 \ --speculative-eagle-topk 1 \ --speculative-num-draft-tokens 4 \ --enable-multi-layer-eagle \ --reasoning-parser mimo \ --tool-call-parser mimo \ --host 0.0.0.0 \ --port 30000 \ --nnodes 2 \ --node-rank \ --dist-init-addr :20000 ``` ### vLLM Follow the [vLLM MiMo-V2.5 recipe](https://recipes.vllm.ai/XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.5). Pre-built image: `docker pull vllm/vllm-openai:mimov25-cu129`. ```bash vllm serve XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL \ --tensor-parallel-size 8 \ --trust-remote-code \ --gpu-memory-utilization 0.95 \ --max-model-len auto \ --reasoning-parser mimo \ --tool-call-parser mimo \ --enable-auto-tool-choice \ --generation-config vllm ``` Recommended sampling: `temperature=1.0`, `top_p=0.95`. Also available in AI Studio, MiMo Code, Xiaomi MiMo Desktop, Xiaomi MiMo Open Platform API, and OpenRouter. ## Citation ```bibtex @misc{mimo2026v26pro, title={MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL}, author={{Xiaomi MiMo Team}}, year={2026}, howpublished={\url{https://huggingface.co/XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL}}, } ``` ## Contact For questions or feedback, reach us at [mimo@xiaomi.com](mailto:mimo@xiaomi.com) or join our community: - [WeChat Group](https://work.weixin.qq.com/apph5/external_room/join/group_mng?plg_id=c417f99bd9014b5dd894daa8bfe19790&) - [Discord](https://discord.gg/WX2R2uNp) - [Telegram](https://t.me/+3T-I0pekOVIyNDBl) - [Reddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/XiaomiMiMo_Official/)

technical_map.focus: 流量／活跃／付费三种并行观察；四个核心观点及各自的证据与边界。

nodes.label: 流量：网页月访问
nodes.limitation: 访问次数不是人数，网页入口未覆盖所有桌面或聊天渠道。
nodes.mechanism: 以网页访问行为排序，观察产品在网页入口获得的注意力。
nodes.result: 提供网页入口的流量视角。
nodes.setting: Similarweb月访问量；报告网页Top 50。

nodes.label: 使用：手机月活
nodes.limitation: 月活不是订阅数，也不是每天使用；不能与网页访问次数相加。
nodes.mechanism: 以手机应用月活用户估计排序，观察移动应用入口。
nodes.result: 提供移动应用的活跃视角。
nodes.setting: Sensor Tower月活用户估计；报告手机Top 50。

nodes.limitation: 不是全球人口普查或公司总营收；消费者卡支付可能含工作用途。
nodes.mechanism: 以美国面板的个人订阅和消费者卡支付观察付费；正文分别保留两项指标的分母。
nodes.result: 用于阅读付费覆盖、消费集中度及付费榜差异。

technical_map.question: 谁在为 AI 付钱？流量榜之外的重度用户

editorial: 用这篇报告选产品时，先确定自己要完成什么任务，再找任务完成质量、重复使用与总成本的直接证据。榜单适合发现候选，无法代替个人试用或团队评估。
后续整理继续保留三种观测口径；比较新旧版本前，先核对样本、入榜规则和统计时段。更换分母后出现的增长，应与同口径增长分开说明。

blocks.text: 先读分母，再读增长。这组统计问的是特定美国面板里的合格消费者是否持有三款产品之一的个人付费订阅；它没有直接回答一个人是否用过AI、每天用了多久，或工作时是否由公司承担费用。

items: 报告观察：高消费群体偏向可用于构建、自动化及创意的工具。产品类别可以提示需要继续研究的任务，却不能替代真实使用日志。
作者判断：更易用的个人Agent，以及广告或交易收入等方式，可能扩大日常使用；本篇没有将这些判断登记成已经实现的采用效果。
本站解读：要验证“做事”的价值，需要任务完成率、质量、重复使用和总成本等证据；一张付款记录无法回答这些问题。

technical_map.question: 百万次重复判断，怎样降低调用费用？

editorial: 采用前同时验证质量、构建投入和完整交付，保留固定蒸馏及专用判断服务作为对照。
这份报告没有验证新数据分布下的质量，也没有给出含硬件、部署和维护的完整生产成本。

items: 两种能力的区别。 逐条问大模型，主要检验它能否答对一道题；自主封装还要求Agent决定哪些计算可以复用、前期投入是否划算，以及能否交付整批结果。作者称后者为bottling（封装）。
封装产物不只有小模型。 Agent可以选择规则程序、检索索引、小模型或混合方案。论文给出完整的未标注工作量，让Agent在有限资源内自行决定实现方式。

blocks.text: 构建投入（探索、标注、训练、验证） → 可复用产物（程序／小模型／索引／混合） → 应用到整批输入。FieldToFit据§3.1整理；构建投入与执行调用分别记录。

blocks.text: 60轮封装中，48轮低于对应零样本95%置信区间下界。

items: 看质量差距。 原图2中紫色是封装质量，浅紫是与零样本的差距，黑色区间是零样本95%置信区间。封装经常没有保住模型原有的答题能力。
看不同任务。 MAVE用F1，ESCI用macro-F1，RAID用AUROC。三列应分别解读，不能把不同指标直接混成一个排名。

blocks.text: 原文定义摘录：“the same question is asked about each of them.”
§3.1：输入内容可以不同，但整个工作量反复回答的是同一个问题。译文为本站整理。

items: MAVE：商品属性提取 · 477万对 · F1
ESCI：查询—商品相关性 · 262万对 · macro-F1
RAID：AI文本检测 · 562万篇 · AUROC
运行规模。 10个模型、3种任务，每个模型任务运行两次，共60轮封装。
资源限制。 OpenCode、单张A100 40GB、8 CPU核、64GB RAM；每轮10小时、500万加权token。未缓存输入、缓存输入、输出的权重分别为1、0.1、2；只能调用被测模型自身的API，不能读取真标签。
交付要求。 预算内交付完整输出；缺失预测使用不含实例信息的回退答案评分。产物执行仍消耗计算资源。

findings.summary: 零样本答题能力强，并不保证Agent能把能力封装成有效产物。
findings.title: 会回答，不代表会构建可复用工具

blocks.alt: 报告原图3：左侧ESCI、右侧RAID的质量与费用图，含Jev和零样本参考线，费用横轴为对数刻度
blocks.attribution: Ankit Sonthalia、Haritz Puerto、Alexander Rubinstein、Martin Gubri、Seong Joon Oh；FieldToFit截取原PDF，仅裁白边，图内未改写
blocks.caption: 报告原图3 · PDF第9页 · v1
blocks.license: CC BY 4.0

items: 与逐条大模型比较。 ESCI上，Opus 5产物的macro-F1为0.499，逐条调用为0.609，约保留其82%。报告封装费用为$26.28；逐条调用的整批外推费用为$17,273，约高657倍。
与Jev比较。 Jev的macro-F1为0.531，整批外推费用为$104.89；该产物约保留其94% macro-F1，论文费用约为四分之一。
图中的费用怎么读。 左图为ESCI、右图为RAID；横轴是对数刻度。橙色虚线是Jev，顶部点线是零样本参考；紫色连线是封装结果的Pareto前沿。

blocks.alt: 报告原表1：十个模型在三项任务及汇总上的封装质量和美元费用，紫色标出Pareto前沿
blocks.attribution: Ankit Sonthalia、Haritz Puerto、Alexander Rubinstein、Martin Gubri、Seong Joon Oh；FieldToFit截取原PDF，仅裁白边，图内未改写
blocks.caption: 报告原表1 · PDF第7页 · v1
blocks.license: CC BY 4.0

blocks.label: limit
blocks.text: 657倍是论文API费用口径的比较，不代表同等质量下的完整生产成本收益。

items: 评测范围不同。 产物质量为两次全量评测均值；逐条调用与Jev使用共同1000条样本。82%是macro-F1的比值，不是准确率。
成本范围有限。 费用采用论文记录的2026年9月价格，不包含完整GPU、部署和维护费用；逐条调用及Jev费用是整批外推。

findings.summary: 费用收益很突出，质量保留程度和费用口径也同样重要。
findings.title: 可复用产物能大幅降低API费用，但要同时看质量损失

blocks.label: evidence
blocks.text: 31/60轮封装不及较强蒸馏学生，21/60轮同时不及两个学生。

items: 对照流程很简单。 GLM 5.3 Flash随机抽样标注，再按公开配方训练Qwen3-0.6B和SmolLM2-360M-Instruct；不做自主决策，也不按任务专门调参。
对照也有相同的token预算。 标注使用500万加权token，每个学生做三次独立训练／评测。原图2中的两条竖虚线表示两名蒸馏学生。
作者要表达的判断。 把预算交给自主Agent，并不保证得到比固定蒸馏更好的结果。这两类统计有包含关系，不能相加成一个失败率。

blocks.text: 比较条件： 相同token预算不等于相同美元或硬件成本；这里比较的是这三种任务和作者设定下的表现。

findings.summary: 相同token预算下，31/60轮封装不及较强蒸馏学生。
findings.title: 自主Agent未必胜过简单的固定蒸馏流程

blocks.alt: 报告原图4：三项任务取消预算强制停止前后的质量对照，实心紫点为原封装、空心紫点为重跑、黑线为零样本
blocks.attribution: Ankit Sonthalia、Haritz Puerto、Alexander Rubinstein、Martin Gubri、Seong Joon Oh；FieldToFit截取原PDF，仅裁白边，图内未改写
blocks.caption: 报告原图4 · PDF第9页 · v1
blocks.license: CC BY 4.0

items: 作者怎样测试。 重跑21轮因预算停止的实验，取消强制停止，再替换对应原运行；低于零样本95%区间的运行从48/60变为47/60。
更多预算确实能帮助部分运行。 图4的实心紫点是原封装，空心紫点是重跑，黑线是零样本。部分模型明显改善，但整体差距没有消失。
有些失败与额度无关。 一次ESCI运行中，Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite把工具截断显示的49条记录当成数百万条的全部，只提交49条答案便标记完成；当时还剩约495万token预算。

blocks.label: claim
blocks.text: 除预算管理外，还要检查输入理解、方案选择与整批交付是否正确。

items: 仅三种任务，每个模型任务两次封装运行；零样本区间由1000条样本、2000次bootstrap估算。
8轮预算耗尽且未交付要求输出，不等于所有预算停止的21轮；未交付完整文件也不等于完全没有预测。
均为作者实验，FieldToFit尚未独立复现。

findings.summary: 取消预算强制停止后，许多运行仍落后于零样本质量。
findings.title: 给Agent更多预算，不能普遍补齐封装能力

reading_materials.body:
Strata

**English** · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [日本語](README.ja.md) · [Deutsch](README.de.md) · [Français](README.fr.md) · [Español](README.es.md) · [Português](README.pt-BR.md)

Run a 125-billion-parameter AI model on your own gaming PC
NVIDIA or AMD graphics card (12 GB or more) · Windows or Linux · free and open source


A voxel pagoda garden, 1 shot prompt running on an RTX 5070 with Strata (IQ3_S, 128K context) · full video (49 s)

Strata runs **[Qwen3.8-Flash-Next](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next)** on a normal PC. This is a large, smart AI model that usually needs a server. It chats, writes code, reads pictures and works with your apps and coding agents. Nothing leaves your PC. ## How fast is it? We measured it on two ordinary gaming PCs. A token is about ¾ of a word. - **Writes answers:** how fast the reply appears in a short chat. 60 tokens per second is faster than you can read. - **Reads your prompt:** how fast it takes in what you send (here a 32K-token document, code or chat history).
NVIDIA: RTX 5070 (12 GB), Ryzen 5 7600, 64 GB RAMAMD: RX 9070 XT (16 GB), Ryzen 9 3900X, 47 GB RAM
| Size | Writes answers | Reads your prompt | | --- | ---: | ---: | | **Q2_0** | 94 tokens/s | 2,650 tokens/s | | **IQ2_XS** | 79 tokens/s | 2,090 tokens/s | | **IQ3_XXS** | 62 tokens/s | 1,750 tokens/s | | **IQ3_S** | 53 tokens/s | 1,620 tokens/s | | **Coder** | 55 tokens/s | 2,180 tokens/s | | Size | Writes answers | Reads your prompt | | --- | ---: | ---: | | **Q2_0** | 60 tokens/s | 1,160 tokens/s | | **IQ2_XS** | 52 tokens/s | 1,110 tokens/s | | **Coder** | 44 tokens/s | 1,420 tokens/s |
NVIDIA: Q2_0 with engine 0.1.36, the other rows with 0.1.26 (4K answers, 32K prompts). The full tables are in [DETAILS.md](docs/DETAILS.md#speed-measured). A card with more VRAM is faster: an RTX 3090 (24 GB) should write about 100-140 tokens per second. Long chats and other cards: [speed of each model](docs/MODELS.md#how-fast-is-each-size), [community results](docs/COMMUNITY_BENCHMARKS.md).


Strata is free. If it runs well on your PC, a coffee keeps the work on it going.

## What you need | | | | --- | --- | | **Graphics card** | **NVIDIA** GeForce RTX 20, 30, 40 or 50 series, or **AMD** Radeon RX 7900 XT / XTX, RX 7800 XT / 7700 XT, RX 9060 XT, RX 9070 / 9070 XT, Radeon AI PRO R9700 or RX 6800 / 6900 series. It needs **12 GB of VRAM or more**. | | **RAM** | 32 GB or more. Your RAM decides [which model](#which-model-should-i-pick) fits. 64 GB runs every size. | | **Disk** | About 80 GB free. Use an SSD if you can: the first start is much faster. | | **System** | Windows 10 / 11 or Linux, and a current graphics driver from NVIDIA or AMD. | The installer sets up everything else. Two or three cards can share the model ([multi-GPU](docs/MULTI_GPU.md)). Experimental, written and tested by community members on their own machines: - **Older graphics cards** (Tesla P40 / V100, GTX 10, Radeon VII / MI50, RX 6700 XT, RX 5500 XT): [Older GPUs](docs/OLDER_GPUS.md). - **Intel Arc**, built from source on Linux: [Intel Arc](docs/INTEL_ARC.md). - **Older processors without AVX2**: they work, but slowly. [Older CPUs](docs/INSTALL.md#older-cpus-experimental). The full list: [docs/INSTALL.md](docs/INSTALL.md#what-you-need). ## Install ### Let your AI set it up Do you use an AI coding assistant (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot, ...)? Paste this into it: ```text Set up Strata on this PC for me: https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata - follow docs/AI_SETUP.md in that repository. ``` It checks your graphics card, RAM and disk and picks the model that fits. Then it installs and starts it and tells you how to connect your apps. AI tools can also install, start and stop Strata through its [MCP server](docs/MCP_SERVER.md). ### Or do it yourself [Download Strata](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/archive/refs/heads/main.zip) and unzip it (or `git clone` it). **Windows:** double-click **`START-HERE.bat`**. **Linux:** run **`./setup.sh`** in the Strata folder. The steps are the same for NVIDIA and AMD. The installer finds your card and sets up the right engine for it. It asks you a few questions: - which model and which size, - how much context (how much text the model keeps in mind), - whether it should read pictures. Press Enter each time for the recommended answer. Then it downloads the model (about 70 GB) and starts it. If the download stops, run it again: it continues where it left off. Your browser opens the Strata app at `http://127.0.0.1:8080`. > **While the model starts, your PC can be slow or stop responding for 1-3 minutes** (longest the first time). > Strata loads 35-55 GB into your RAM and locks part of it for the graphics card. This is normal. Wait, and don't > close the window. The window shows what Strata is doing. **Next time**, run `START-HERE.bat` (or `./setup.sh`) again. It starts right away and downloads nothing twice. Close its window to stop the model. `UPDATE.bat` (`./update.sh`) updates Strata without starting it. Updating, Docker, several cards, where the files go and every option: [docs/INSTALL.md](docs/INSTALL.md). ## Which model should I pick? The installer recommends one for your RAM. The same model comes in several sizes, compressed more or less. Smaller sizes are faster. Larger sizes are a bit smarter. | Your RAM | Take | Why | | --- | --- | --- | | **32 GB** | **Coder** | it fits 32 GB, and it is made for code (with a 24 GB card, Q2_0 and IQ2_XS run too) | | **48 GB** | **IQ2_XS** (or Q2_0, the fastest) | the larger sizes do not fit | | **64 GB** | **IQ2_XS** (recommended), or IQ3_XXS / IQ3_S | every size fits; IQ3_S is the best and the slowest | | **96 GB or more** | **IQ3_S**, or Unsloth's UD-IQ4_XS (~4-bit) | room for the largest sizes with everything else open | - **[Coder](docs/MODELS.md#coder):** a coding version with half of the experts removed. It reaches 91% of the full model's SWE-bench Verified score (measured by its authors) and fits 32 GB of RAM. It is weaker outside code, including Chinese and other CJK text (#438). For those, take Q2_0, IQ2_XS or IQ3_S, which keep every expert. - **[Swift 1.5](docs/MODELS.md#swift-15):** a fine-tune that thinks for a much shorter time before it answers. You get the answer sooner, at about the same quality. - **[Unsloth UD-IQ4_XS](docs/MODELS.md#unsloth-ud-iq4_xs):** Unsloth's ~4-bit version, between IQ3_S and UD-Q4_K_XL in quality. A 94 GB download. With less than ~80 GB of RAM, Strata reads part of it from the SSD while it answers, so it is slower there (an NVMe SSD helps). - **[Unsloth UD-Q4_K_XL](docs/MODELS.md#unsloth-ud-q4_k_xl-experimental)** (experimental): the closest to the full model. But Strata reads most of it from the SSD while it answers, so it writes only 7-8.5 tokens/s on a 64 GB PC. - **[OrcaRouter's Uncensored IQ3_XXS](docs/MODELS.md#orcarouter-uncensored-iq3_xxs):** you set it up by hand. It is not in the installer's menu. Sizes, downloads and what fits where: [docs/MODELS.md](docs/MODELS.md). To add another model later, run `SETUP.bat` (Linux: `./setup.sh --setup`). ## Using it


The Strata app's Monitor (left) while a coding agent writes the pagoda garden from the video (right)

- **In the browser:** open `http://127.0.0.1:8080`. It has **Chat**, a live **Monitor** of the model and your GPU/CPU/RAM, and **About** with the settings and addresses. - **Your apps and coding agents:** add an "OpenAI-compatible" provider with the base URL **`http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1`**. Any API key and any model name work. - Apps that use Anthropic's API: `http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/messages` (Claude Code: `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8080`). - Codex CLI and other apps that use the OpenAI Responses API: `/v1/responses` ([setup](docs/DETAILS.md#the-responses-api-and-codex-cli)). - **Thinking:** choose **off, low, medium or high** in the chat menu or in your app's "reasoning effort". Off is the fastest. High is best for hard questions. - **Pictures:** say yes to "Images?" in setup. Then click **Picture** in the chat, or attach pictures in your app. AMD cards read pictures on Linux through the processor; on Windows they can't yet. - **From your phone or another PC:** `START-HERE.bat --setup --host 0.0.0.0 --api-key `. Always set a key. - **One request at a time:** by default Strata answers one request, and the others wait. To answer several at once, set `"parallel": 2` ([BATCHING.md](docs/BATCHING.md)). On a 12 GB card this makes each answer slower. - **Long prompts:** Strata reads the first message of a chat in full, about 1 minute per 30,000 tokens. Follow-up messages start in seconds. More: [where your chats are stored](docs/INSTALL.md#where-things-are-stored), [the API](docs/DETAILS.md#using-it). ## Something went wrong? - **My PC froze the first time Strata started.** This is normal while it loads the model. Wait, and don't close the window. Still frozen after 10 minutes? Restart the PC, close other programs and try again, or pick a smaller size. - **It stopped while downloading or installing.** Run `START-HERE.bat` (or `./setup.sh`) again. It continues where it stopped. - **It's very slow and the disk light keeps blinking, or it says "the engine stopped unexpectedly".** Your PC does not have enough free RAM. Close other programs (browsers use a lot), or pick a smaller size (Q2_0 or IQ2_XS). - **It says port 8080 is already in use.** Strata is already running. Look for its window. More problems and their fixes: [docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md). Still stuck? Open an [issue](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/issues) and attach `strata-.log` from the Strata folder. Found a security problem? Report it privately: [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). ## How does it work? Models like this one usually run on servers with hundreds of gigabytes of graphics memory. Your graphics card has 12-24 GB. Strata makes the model fit by **sharing the work across your whole PC**. Think of a kitchen: the things you use all the time stay on the counter, and the rest waits in the pantry.

- **The model is a team of 24,576 small specialists ("experts").** Each word needs only 10 of them. - **Your graphics card** keeps the few thousand experts that are used most often. **Your RAM** holds all of them, and **your processor** works on the rest at the same time. **Your SSD** holds a big lookup table.

- **Guess, then check:** a small helper guesses the next few words. The big model checks them all at once. You get the same answer, 1.6-1.8x sooner. - **Long texts are read in big pieces** (up to 8,192 tokens at a time), at over 1,000 tokens per second. The longer explanation: [docs/HOW_IT_WORKS.md](docs/HOW_IT_WORKS.md). Every part and its numbers: [the details](docs/DETAILS.md#how-it-works) and the [paper](docs/paper/Strata-Paper.pdf). ## Credits and license The model is [Qwen3.8-Flash-Next](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next) by the Qwen team. It was compressed by [ISTA-DASLab](https://huggingface.co/ISTA-DASLab/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO-GGUF), UkisAI (Swift 1.5) and Unsloth. Strata uses parts of [llama.cpp / ggml](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp). All credits: [docs/HOW_IT_WORKS.md](docs/HOW_IT_WORKS.md#credits). Strata is open source under the [MIT License](LICENSE). A few parts and every model have their own licenses ([which ones](docs/HOW_IT_WORKS.md#license)). ## Support Strata Strata is free and open source. If it is useful to you, you can support its development:

--- title: Cloudflare Web Search API description: Ground AI agents and applications with real-time web search results from Ceramic.ai, Exa, and Linkup through AI Gateway. pcx_content_type: overview tags: - AI sidebar: order: 1 head: - tag: title content: Overview products: - web-search --- import { CardGrid, Description, Feature, LinkButton, LinkTitleCard, Plan, RelatedProduct, } from "~/components"; Give your agents real-time web context with a single API call. Web Search API lets your AI agents and applications search the Internet and ground their responses in live information. Instead of guessing URLs or relying on a model's training cutoff, your agent sends a search query and receives structured results — titles, URLs, and descriptions — that you can pass straight into a model's context. Web Search API runs through [AI Gateway](/ai-gateway/), so every search gets the same logging, analytics, billing, and access controls as your model inference requests. You can call it from any backend with the REST API, or from a Worker with the AI binding.
How to use{" "} Browse providers
--- ## Features Choose between Ceramic.ai, Exa, and Linkup with a single `provider` parameter. All providers return results in the same format, so you can switch without changing your code. Pay for searches with your AI Gateway credits at each provider's list API price, with no additional markup. You can also bring your own provider API key. Search requests appear in your AI Gateway logs and analytics alongside your model inference requests. Every provider commits to Cloudflare's [verified bot](/bots/concepts/bot/verified-bots/) requirements and returns a link to the source of every result. --- ## Related products Observe and control your AI applications with analytics, caching, rate limiting, and model fallback. Run machine learning models, powered by serverless GPUs, on Cloudflare's global network. Build AI-powered agents that can perform tasks, persist state, browse the web, and communicate in real time. --- ## More resources Connect with the Workers community on Discord to ask questions, show what you are building, and discuss the platform with other developers. Learn how you can build and deploy ambitious AI applications to Cloudflare's global network. Follow @CloudflareDev on Twitter to learn about product announcements, and what is new in Cloudflare Workers.

reading_materials.body:
---
title: Providers
description: Compare Web Search API providers Ceramic.ai, Exa, and Linkup, including Zero Data Retention terms and list API pricing.
pcx_content_type: reference
sidebar:
  order: 4
tags:
  - AI
products:
  - web-search
---

Web Search API supports the following search providers. Set the `provider` parameter in your request to choose one. If you do not set a provider, Web Search API uses Ceramic.ai as default.

When you pay with [AI Gateway credits](/ai-gateway/features/unified-billing/), each search is billed at the provider's list API price, with no additional markup. If you [bring your own key](/web-search/how-to-use/#bring-your-own-key-byok), the provider bills you directly under your own agreement with them.

## [Ceramic.ai](https://ceramic.ai/)

Ceramic.ai is the default provider for Web Search API. Ceramic.ai runs its own independent web index of more than 40 billion pages, designed for AI agents and LLM applications rather than human search.

Ceramic.ai focuses on low-latency, low-cost search, which makes it a good fit for agents that run many searches per task, for grounding chatbot answers in current information, and for checking model output against live web sources. Results include long descriptions of each page, up to 8,000 characters.

| Property            | Value                                                   |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `provider`          | `ceramic`                                               |
| Zero Data Retention | Yes                                                     |
| Price               | $0.25 per 1,000 requests                                |
| Documentation       | [Ceramic.ai documentation](https://docs.ceramic.ai/)    |
| Terms               | [Terms of service](https://ceramic.ai/terms-of-service) |

## [Exa](https://exa.ai/)

Exa is a search engine built for AI, with its own index that combines traditional keyword search with embeddings-based search. Web Search API uses the [Exa Search API](https://exa.ai/docs/reference/search).

Requests use Exa's `auto` search type, a balanced mode that Exa optimizes for both result quality and speed. Each result includes highlights — the text snippets from the page that are most relevant to your query — returned as the result description. Exa is a good fit when you want to pass concise, query-relevant excerpts straight into a model's context.

| Property            | Value                                                                             |
| ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `provider`          | `exa`                                                                             |
| Zero Data Retention | No                                                                               |
| Price               | $7.00 per 1,000 requests                                                          |
| Search mode         | `auto` search type, with page highlights returned as the result description       |
| Documentation       | [Exa Search API documentation](https://exa.ai/docs/reference/search)              |
| Terms               | [Exa Terms (PDF)](https://exa.ai/assets/Exa_Labs_Terms_of_Service.pdf) |

## [Linkup](https://www.linkup.so/)

Linkup provides web search built for AI applications, returning sourced results with text snippets from across the web. Web Search API uses the [Linkup Search API](https://docs.linkup.so/pages/documentation/endpoints/search/overview).

Requests use Linkup's `fast` search depth with raw search results, so Linkup returns results without generating an answer. This makes Linkup a good fit for agent tool calls that need quick, cited results from trusted sources.

| Property            | Value                                              |
| ------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `provider`          | `linkup`                                           |
| Zero Data Retention | Yes                                                |
| Price               | $5.00 per 1,000 requests                           |
| Search mode         | `fast` search depth                                |
| Documentation       | [Linkup documentation](https://docs.linkup.so/)    |
| Terms               | [Terms of use](https://www.linkup.so/terms-of-use) |
